jobs.title: Executive Assistant
jobs.summary: In the role of Executive Assistant, you will provide essential support to executives by managing their daily office activities. This includes organizing information for reports, scheduling meetings, and handling confidential information. Your organizational skills and attention to detail will be crucial in ensuring smooth operations and effective communication within the team.
jobs.description:
Location:
Dammam, Eastern Region, Saudi Arabia
Job ID:
R0141544
Date Posted:
2026-09-17
Company Name:
HITACHI ENERGY LTD
Profession (Job Category):
Administration & Facilities
Job Schedule:
Full time
Remote:
No
Job Description:
The opportunity
Executive Assistant work is focused on supporting an individual executive or small number of executives in their day-to-day office activities including Obtaining and organizing information for use in conferences, speeches, and reports as requested by the executive, editing, proofing, formatting, document design/production, form filling, and data entry. In addition, scheduling/coordinating meetings, diaries, and travel arrangements. Also, receiving/relaying telephone messages from internal and external sources, managing the time/interaction executives have with internal and external sources Typically this role is required to handle confidential business and personnel information.
How you’ll make an impact
- Organizing and servicing meetings (producing agendas and taking minutes).
- Prioritizing workloads and implementing new procedures and administrative systems.
- Liaising with relevant organizations and clients and logging or processing bills or expenses.
- Acting as a receptionist and/or meeting and greeting clients and greeting visitors and directing them to the appropriate departments or individuals.
- Answer telephones and respond to inquiries via telephone or email and book meeting rooms, set up conference calls and take messages and minutes during meetings.
- Perform administrative tasks, including filing and photocopying, writing emails, memos and letters.
- Implement and/or develop office procedures and record systems and manage database entry and client files. Order and maintain supplies and document financial information.
- Organize and distribute messages, make and confirm travel arrangements Prepare and mail outgoing correspondence.
- Maintain confidential department files/records and perform routine bookkeeping tasks and assist with presentations and reports.
- Responsible for ensuring compliance with applicable external and internal regulations, procedures, and guidelines.
- Living Hitachi Energy core values of safety and integrity, which means taking responsibility for your own actions while caring for your colleagues and the business.
Your background
- A bachelor’s degree in Business Administration or related degree.
- 5+ Years of experience in international companies.
- Good communication, customer service and relationship-building skills.
- Teamworking skills and organization and time management skills.
- Attention to detail, negotiation skills, Assertiveness and flexibility and tact, discretion and diplomacy.
- The ability to be proactive and use your initiative: to see what needs doing and to do it.
- The ability to use standard software packages (e.g. Microsoft Office) and to learn bespoke packages if required.
- Proficiency in both spoken & written English language is required.
Accessibility and reasonable accommodation
Qualified individuals with a disability may request a reasonable accommodation if you are unable or limited in your ability to use or access the Hitachi Energy career site as a result of your disability. You may request reasonable accommodations by completing a general inquiry form on our website. Please include your contact information and specific details about your required accommodation to support you during the job application process.
This is solely for job seekers with disabilities requiring accessibility assistance or an accommodation in the job application process. Messages left for other purposes will not receive a response.
Use of Al and automated tools in recruitment
As part of our recruitment process, Hitachi Energy uses digital and automated tools, including Al-supported solutions, to assist with activities such as application screening, job matching, and interview scheduling. These tools are designed to support our recruiters and do not replace human decision-making. Candidate data is processed in accordance with applicable data protection and employment laws as well as Hitachi's Global Data Privacy Notice.
Background Screening and Security Checks
As part of the hiring process, Hitachi Energy conducts pre-employment background checks that may include verification of employment history, education, criminal records, and other relevant information, in accordance with applicable laws.
For certain roles—particularly those involving access to sensitive information, financial responsibilities, client data, regulated environments, or security-sensitive functions—additional or more comprehensive background or security screenings may be required. These may include, but are not limited to, enhanced criminal history checks, credit history reviews (where legally permissible), sanctions screening, or other due diligence measures aligned with the responsibilities of the position.
The scope and depth of any background or security review will be determined based on the nature of the role and business necessity, and will always be conducted in compliance with applicable federal, state, and local laws. Candidates will be notified and, where required, asked to provide consent prior to the initiation of any such checks.

jobs.title: Office , Fleet & Administration Manager
jobs.summary: KONE is recognized as a Top Employer, committed to creating a better work environment through exceptional people practices. We seek a proactive Office, Fleet & Administration Manager to oversee operations across KSA, ensuring efficiency and quality in facilities, fleet, travel, and administration. This role demands strong leadership in managing budgets, contracts, and supplier relationships while fostering a collaborative culture.
jobs.description:
Certified as a Top Employer; KONE is dedicated to a better world of work and exhibits this through excellent people practices. We are committed to fostering a great work culture and inspiring the highest standards of quality and efficiency putting our people first and creating a workplace that nurtures collaboration, diversity, growth and wellbeing.
It's time to make a move. Join our flow.
We are looking for an energetic and enthusiastic Office, Fleet & Administration Manager who to lead the end-to-end operations of Facilities, Fleet, Travel, and Administration for KONE Saudi Arabia.
The role is responsible for managing offices, staff accommodation, vehicle fleet, travel, and administrative services across all KSA locations.
As the Department Owner, the position is accountable for the department’s budget, cost optimization and savings, governance, and all related contracts and service providers.
What will you do?
- Runs the day-to-day operations of the department independently across all KSA locations. Sets priorities, service standards and coverage.
- Acts as Department Owner for Facilities, Fleet, and Administration in KSA: defining local requirements, demand and service standards, and working with Purchasing manager and Area Category Managers.
- Deploys the region Facilities related policies locally. Develops and maintains KSA guidelines where no regional or global instrument exists: Accommodation standards, parking, camp operations, travel, fuel control and office services.
- Owns all department contracts locally across their full lifecycle: scope, SLA and performance terms, cost and commercial mechanisms, variations, renewal, extension and exit. Maintains the department contract register and ensures no service runs off contract.
- Full line management of the department and the Facilities team: Resourcing and hiring, objective setting, yearly performance monitoring and review and skills development.
- Manages supplier relationships and performance against contracted SLAs. Runs periodic supplier reviews, drives corrective action and escalates persistent underperformance.
- Works with the Purchasing team to run sourcing events and secure approvals.
- Manages all matters relating to staff accommodation: licensing and dealings with government entities and regulators, inspections and regulatory compliance, daily operations, occupancy and employee welfare and needs, maintenance, cleaning, catering, security and utilities.
- Leases, fit-out and office projects, maintenance, utilities, reception standards, courier, printer services and office supplies.
- Fleet register integrity, allocation, fuel control, maintenance, insurance, lease administration, disposal and deregistration.
- Travel booked through the mandated channel, policy compliance and spend monitoring. Administrative services delivered to a consistent standard across all sites.
- Owns the department budget: planning, forecast, monthly review, accruals and variance explanation. Delivers annual savings targets.
- Ensures all department requirements are raised, approved and processed through the correct purchasing channel and within the Delegation of Authority, and that invoices, receipting and submissions to Finance are complete, accurate and on time.
- Collaborate with HSE department to ensure all our venues are per KONE standards.
- Works with Purchasing, Finance, HSE, HR and Operations to secure day-to-day business support. Coordinates with regional and global Category and Facilities teams on strategy and initiative rollout in KSA.
- Full line management of the department: resourcing and hiring, objective setting, performance monitoring and review, development, discipline and separation, coverage and succession planning.
- Build and communicate periodic reporting on the categories managed: spend, savings, budget variance, SLA and KPI performance, compliance status, occupancy and fleet utilization. Prepares and presents management reporting to leadership.
Are you the one?
- Bachelor degree in Business Administration or related field.
- Minimum 7 years of experience in facilities management, including multi-site responsibility.
- Minimum 4 years managing specialists and administrative teams.
- Contract management: SLA governance, commercial terms, renewals and supplier performance.
- Working familiarity with Procurement & Finance processes.
- KSA regulatory understanding: labor accommodation, municipality licensing, experience dealing with government authorities.
- Basic skills in SAP or equivalent ERP.
- Microsoft Office; use of AI and LLM tools in daily work.
- Report building, data analysis and presentation skills.
- Excellent English & Arabic communication skills.
What do we offer?
- Great dynamic team promoting a collaborative environment.
- Total reward elements that engage and motivate our employees and help us make KONE a great place to work.
- Comprehensive learning and development programs covering a wide range of professional skills.
- Engaging job with position description and clear targets.
- Regular feedback through performance discussions.
- Opportunities for individual development.
- Mentoring and coaching programs.
At KONE, we are focused on creating an innovative and collaborative working culture where we value the contribution of each individual. Employee engagement is a key focus area for us and we encourage participation and the sharing of information and ideas. Sustainability is an integral part of our culture and the daily practice. We follow ethical business practices and we seek to develop a culture of working together where co-workers trust and respect each other and good performance is recognized. In being a great place to work, we are proud to offer a range of experiences and opportunities that will help you to achieve your career and personal goals and enable you to live a healthy and balanced life.
Read more on https://kone.com/global/en/careers.html

jobs.title: Front Desk Administrator
jobs.summary: The Front Desk Administrator is essential for enhancing sales growth and ensuring client retention through a professional and welcoming guest experience. This role oversees reception operations, manages appointments, and supports retail activities, all while adhering to Furless standards and Saudi Municipality regulations.
jobs.description:
The Front Desk Administrator plays a key role in driving sales growth and client retention while delivering a warm, professional, and seamless experience for every guest. This role manages reception operations, sales follow-up, appointment scheduling, and retail support, ensuring all front-of-house activities meet Furless standards and comply with Saudi Municipality regulations.
Key Responsibilities
1. Client Experience & Reception
- Greet, register, and guide clients with warmth and professionalism, ensuring every visitor feels welcomed and valued.
- Maintain clear communication in English and/or Arabic; respond to phone, WhatsApp, and email inquiries promptly and accurately.
- Manage appointment bookings, confirmations, and reminders to maximize show-up rates.
- Handle complaints empathetically and resolve issues quickly to preserve client loyalty.
- Ensure reception and waiting areas always reflect Furless premium standards – clean, organized, and inviting.
2. Sales & Client Retention
- Promote treatments, packages, and retail products confidently and professionally.
- Educate clients on home-care routines and follow-up treatments to encourage repeat visits.
- Actively track and follow up with lapsed or prospective clients to increase return rate.
- Meet or exceed monthly sales and upselling targets set by the Operations Manager.
- Support in-branch marketing or promotional activities to boost new-client acquisition.
- Maintain client records, purchase history, and preferences to enable personalized retention strategies.
3. Administrative & Operational Support
- Record all bookings, payments, and transactions accurately in the CRM/POS system.
- Perform daily cash-up and reconciliation in coordination with Finance.
- Generate and submit daily and weekly performance reports (appointments, revenue, client feedback).
- Maintain compliance with Saudi Municipality standards on hygiene, safety, and documentation.
- Coordinate with the Operations Manager on maintenance, supply orders, and equipment servicing.
4. Professionalism & Team Alignment
- Uphold the Furless image – groomed, polished, and brand-representative at all times.
- Collaborate with therapists, treatment coordinators, and management to ensure smooth client flow.
- Participate in sales and service training sessions to improve conversion and retention skills.
- Demonstrate punctuality, accountability, and adaptability to rotating shifts (including weekends if required).
Work Schedule & Compensation
- Hours: 48 hours per week / 2 days off (rotational).
- Compensation: Competitive salary + commission based on sales and retention performance.
- Benefits: Medical insurance, training programs, and career development per Furless KSA policy.
Skills
Qualifications & Skills
- Education: High school diploma or higher (Diploma in Administration, Customer Service, or related field preferred).
- Experience: 1–3 years in front desk, sales, or customer-service role (preferably clinic, beauty, wellness, or hospitality).
- Technical: Proficient in MS Office and CRM/booking systems (Fresha experience preferred).
- Communication: Fluent in English (required); Arabic advantageous.
- Sales & Retention: Strong persuasion, upselling, and relationship-building skills.
- Organization: Excellent multitasking and time-management abilities.
- Compliance: Knowledge of Saudi MOH/Municipality hygiene standards (training provided).
Personal Attributes
- Sales-driven yet service-oriented mindset.
- Professional, approachable, and emotionally intelligent.
- Honest, reliable, and attentive to detail.
- Calm and confident under pressure.
- Passionate about beauty, wellness, and client satisfaction.

jobs.title: Spa Receptionist
jobs.summary: As a Spa Receptionist, you will play a crucial role in ensuring a seamless experience for guests by scheduling services and confirming appointments. Your responsibilities include managing reservations, addressing guest inquiries, and promoting spa services while maintaining a professional environment. This position requires strong communication skills and attention to detail to enhance guest satisfaction and uphold company standards.
jobs.description:
POSITION SUMMARY
Schedule services for individuals and large groups using spa/salon reservations software system. Call guests to confirm scheduled services. Answer questions about available services. Update the reservations/cancellations list throughout the day, inform providers of last-minute changes, and resolve scheduling issues as needed by working with supervisor/manager. Check in guests for appointments, confirm first and last name, and provide general spa orientation to guests upon arrival. Promote and sell spa/salon services. Obtain assigned bank and ensure accuracy of contracted monies, obtain change required for expected business level, and keep bank secure at all times. Process guest payments for spa/salon services and obtain payment authorization as needed. Accept and log cash tips for employees. Balance, scan, and drop receipts with Accounting. Notify Engineering of maintenance and repair needs.
Report accidents, injuries, and unsafe work conditions to manager. Follow all company policies and procedures; ensure uniform and personal appearance are clean and professional; maintain confidentiality of proprietary information; protect company assets. Welcome and acknowledge all guests according to company standards; anticipate and address guests’ service needs; assist individuals with disabilities; thank guests with genuine appreciation. Speak with others using clear and professional language; answer telephones using appropriate etiquette. Develop and maintain positive working relationships with others. Comply with quality assurance expectations and standards. Stand, sit, or walk for an extended period of time. Move, lift, carry, push, pull, and place objects weighing less than or equal to 10 pounds without assistance. Perform other reasonable job duties as requested by Supervisors.
PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS
Education: High school diploma or G.E.D. equivalent.

The Executive Secretary may also provide administrative support to other key Department Heads in accordance with internal hotel requirements.

Executive Office & Administration
- Provide comprehensive secretarial and administrative support to the Regional General Manager.
- Manage calendars, appointments, meetings, correspondence, and daily office activities.
- Prepare business correspondence, memoranda, reports, forms, and confidential documents.
- Maintain an organized filing and document management system.
- Answer and channel telephone calls and receive and screen visitors and office callers.
- Receive, sort, distribute, and dispatch incoming and outgoing correspondence.

- Maintain the cleanliness and organization of the Executive Office.
Meetings & Information Management

- Maintain records of daily briefings, follow-ups, and important information for the Regional General Manager.

jobs.title: Risk Engineer
jobs.summary: AtkinsRealis seeks a skilled Risk Engineer, ideally a Saudi National, to oversee the identification and mitigation of various project risks. This role requires expertise in conducting risk assessments and implementing preventive measures to ensure safe and compliant operations. The successful candidate will play a crucial role in enhancing project delivery by establishing effective risk management frameworks and strategies.
jobs.description:
Job DescriptionOverview
AtkinsRealis is looking for an experienced Risk Engineer (ideally Saudi National), who will be responsible for identifying, assessing, and mitigating operational, technical, safety, and business risks across projects and assets.
The role involves conducting risk assessments, recommending preventive measures, and supporting the organization in achieving safe, compliant, and reliable operations.
Your role
- Conduct comprehensive risk assessments across infrastructure projects, assets, facilities, and operations to identify potential threats and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
- Identify, assess, and evaluate strategic, technical, operational, commercial, safety, schedule, and cost-related risks that may impact project delivery and performance.
- Facilitate risk identification workshops and stakeholder sessions to proactively capture project risks, assumptions, constraints, and dependencies.
- Perform qualitative and quantitative risk analyses utilizing recognized methodologies, including HAZOP, FMEA, Bow-Tie Analysis, Quantitative Risk Assessment (QRA), sensitivity analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations.
- Develop, maintain, and regularly update project risk registers, ensuring risks are appropriately categorized, assigned, monitored, and closed.
- Establish risk mitigation, contingency, and response plans to reduce project exposure and improve delivery certainty.
- Evaluate engineering designs, construction methodologies, and operational processes to ensure risk management principles are embedded during planning and execution stages.
- Monitor and assess risks associated with design development, procurement, supply chain management, construction activities, stakeholder interfaces, regulatory approvals, and operational readiness.
- Analyze incident investigations, audit findings, near misses, and failure reports to identify root causes, lessons learned, and preventive actions.
- Support project controls and planning teams by assessing the impact of risks on project schedules, budgets, resources, and key milestones.
- Review compliance with applicable regulatory requirements, industry standards, client specifications, and corporate risk management frameworks.
- Participate in design reviews, constructability reviews, value engineering workshops, and project stage-gate reviews to provide risk-based insights and recommendations.
- Prepare and present risk dashboards, heat maps, trend analyses, and executive risk reports to project leadership, clients, and governance committees.
- Support insurance risk assessments and coordinate with insurers, contractors, consultants, auditors, and regulatory authorities on risk-related matters.
- Assess contractor and consultant risk management practices to ensure alignment with project objectives and contractual requirements.
- Provide recommendations to enhance asset integrity, operational reliability, process safety, business continuity, and project resilience.
- Monitor emerging project risks, market conditions, regulatory changes, and industry best practices to strengthen risk management effectiveness.
- Establish Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and performance metrics to measure risk exposure and mitigation effectiveness.
- Support change management processes by evaluating the potential risk and opportunity impacts of project changes and variations.
- Promote a proactive risk management culture by providing guidance, training, and risk awareness sessions across project teams and stakeholders
About you
- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering or related disciplie
- With at least 5 years of experience in Risk Management and has been involved in the development, implementation, and continuous enhancement of project-specific Risk Management Frameworks
- Establish and maintain comprehensive risk registers, ensuring all strategic, technical, commercial, operational, schedule, and stakeholder risks are effectively identified, assessed, monitored, and mitigated.
- Facilitate risk identification workshops, brainstorming sessions, and stakeholder engagement meetings to proactively capture emerging threats and opportunities throughout the project lifecycle.
- Conduct qualitative and quantitative risk assessments, including probability-impact analysis, risk scoring, scenario planning, sensitivity analysis, and Monte Carlo simulations.
- Develop risk mitigation, avoidance, transfer, acceptance, and contingency strategies to minimize project exposure and enhance project delivery certainty.
- Monitor critical project risks related to design, procurement, construction, regulatory approvals, stakeholder management, environmental impacts, and contractual obligations.
- Integrate risk management processes with project controls, planning, scheduling, cost management, and change management functions to provide a holistic project risk perspective.
- Evaluate schedule and cost impacts arising from identified risks and support the development of realistic contingencies and management reserves.
- Support project leadership and client teams in making informed decisions through risk-based analysis, reporting, forecasting, and recommendations.
- Establish Key Risk Indicators (KRIs) and risk performance metrics to measure project risk exposure and monitor mitigation effectiveness.
- Prepare and present risk reports, dashboards, heat maps, and executive summaries for project leadership, clients, and governance committees.
- Ensure compliance with client risk management requirements, corporate governance standards, and contractual obligations.
- Assess contractor and consultant risk management practices to ensure alignment with project objectives and risk management expectations.
- Lead risk reviews at key project milestones, stage gates, and governance meetings to support effective project decision-making.
- Identify opportunities that deliver cost savings, schedule improvements, operational efficiencies, and enhanced project outcomes.
- Manage strategic and enterprise-level risks across large-scale infrastructure portfolios, programs, and mega projects.
- Coordinate with multidisciplinary stakeholders, including engineering, construction, commercial, procurement, legal, and operational teams, to ensure risks are effectively managed across all project functions.
- Support claims avoidance and dispute mitigation through proactive risk identification, documentation, and management of contractual risks.
- Develop and deliver risk management training, awareness programs, and coaching sessions to strengthen risk culture across project teams.
- Provide independent challenge and assurance on project risk exposure, ensuring risks are accurately reflected in project forecasts, schedules, and delivery strategies.
Rewards & benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
- Tax-free salary.
- Life insurance coverage.
- Medical insurance.
- Annual leave balance.
- Company gratuity scheme.
- Discretionary bonus program.
- Annual flight contribution.
- Transportation & housing allowances.
- Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.
About AtkinsRéalis
We're AtkinsRéalis, a world-class engineering services and nuclear organization. We connect people, data and technology to transform the world's infrastructure and energy systems. Together, with our industry partners and clients, and our global team of consultants, designers, engineers and project managers, we can change the world. We're committed to leading our clients across our various end markets to engineer a better future for our planet and its people. Find out more.
Worker TypeEmployeeJob TypeRegular
At AtkinsRéalis, we seek to hire individuals with diverse characteristics, backgrounds and perspectives. We strongly believe that world-class talent makes no distinctions based on gender, ethnic or national origin, sexual identity and orientation, age, religion or disability, but enriches itself through these differences.

Context
We are looking for a Design Engineer – Civil Infrastructure & Roads to join our team and support the planning and design of infrastructure and roadworks projects. The role is suited for a candidate with strong technical knowledge, practical design experience, and a good understanding of local and regional standards within KSA/GCC.

The ideal candidate should be able to work closely with multidisciplinary teams, coordinate with internal and external stakeholders, and contribute to the successful delivery of projects from concept through detailed design.

- Prepare and develop design drawings, calculations, reports, and technical specifications for civil infrastructure and road projects.
- Support the planning and design of roads, grading, utilities, drainage, and related infrastructure elements.

- Support the preparation of tender and construction documentation.
- Contribute to resolving design issues and responding to technical queries during project delivery.

- Bachelor’s degree in Civil Engineering.

- Experience in Saudi Arabia will be preferred.
- Arabic speaker is required.
- Good knowledge of relevant design standards, authority requirements, and engineering best practices in the region.
- Strong coordination and communication skills.

jobs.description:
عن الشركة - Wiyyana من Huspy
وّيانا من هسبي هي جزء من شركة Huspy، إحدى الشركات الرائدة في مجال التكنولوجيا العقارية في منطقة أوروبا والشرق الأوسط وإفريقيا EMEA. منذ انطلاقتها في عام 2020 حققت Huspy نمواً سريعاً في مختلف أنحاء الإمارات وأوروبا، وأصبحت تعمل اليوم في مدن رئيسية داخل دولة الإمارات العربية المتحدة وإسبانيا، مع توسع جارٍ إلى المملكة العربية السعودية وثلاثة أسواق أوروبية إضافية قيد التنفيذ. وقد حصلت الشركة على تمويل يتجاوز 140 مليون دولار من مستثمرين عالميين بارزين مثل Sequoia Capital وFounders Fund وBalderton Capital. وتعمل Huspy على إعادة تشكيل تجربة شراء المنازل من خلال التكنولوجيا والابتكار والأدوات الذكية المصممة لخدمة الوكلاء والعملاء.
وبصفتها أكبر جهة في سوق الرهن العقاري في الإمارات، وواحدة من أسرع شركات التكنولوجيا العقارية نمواً في أوروبا، فقد طورت Huspy تطبيقاً فائقاً (SuperApp) يمنح وكلاء العقارات ووسطاء الرهن العقاري أدوات متطورة وحديثة، مما يساهم في تحويل واحدة من أكثر الصناعات التقليدية في العالم إلى تجربة أسرع وأكثر ذكاءً وسلاسة.
تمتد Wiyyana بهذا التميز إلى المملكة العربية السعودية، حيث تقدم خدمة استشارات عقارية متكاملة وعالية المستوى للعملاء الراغبين في تحديد وتقييم وامتلاك الفرص العقارية المناسبة بثقة ودقة. ومن خلال الجمع بين فهم السوق والخبرة المتخصصة والخصوصية التامة، صُممت Wiyyana للارتقاء بتجربة القطاع العقاري في المملكة.
استناداً إلى نموذج التشغيل والتقنية والخبرة المثبتة لدى Huspy، تستفيد Wiyyana من التوسع في الأسواق العالمية، ويضمن هذا الأساس سرعة التنفيذ وسلاسة العمليات وتقديم تجربة موثوقة وراقية لجميع الأطراف المعنية.
مع توسع حضورها الذي يشمل دبي وأبوظبي ومدريد وفالنسيا وأليكانتي وإيبيزا ومالقا، تسير Huspy بخطى ثابتة لتصبح أكبر شركة لشراء المنازل في أوروبا والشرق الأوسط — وتعد Wiyyana أحد الركائز الأساسية في هذا التوسع.
انضم إلينا وكن جزءاً من بناء مستقبل القطاع العقاري في المملكة العربية السعودية وما بعدها.

jobs.title: Architect - Building
jobs.summary: As an Architect (Building), you will oversee architectural works during construction, ensuring adherence to designs, specifications, and quality standards. Your expertise will be crucial in delivering complex building projects while maintaining architectural integrity and construction quality throughout the project lifecycle.
jobs.description:
Job DescriptionOverview
The Architect (Building) will be responsible for supervising and monitoring architectural works during the construction phase to ensure compliance with approved designs, project specifications, quality standards, and contractual requirements. The role will support the successful delivery of complex building projects by ensuring architectural integrity, design intent, functionality, aesthetics, and construction quality are maintained throughout project execution.
Your role
Construction Supervision
- Inspect architectural works including building finishes, facades, roofing systems, partitions, ceilings, doors, windows, and fit-out works.
- Verify that construction activities are executed in accordance with approved drawings, specifications, and applicable codes.
- Monitor workmanship standards and ensure architectural details are constructed to the required quality levels.
- Witness inspections and mock-up reviews to confirm compliance with project requirements.
- Identify deficiencies and ensure timely implementation of corrective actions by contractors.
Technical Review and Coordination
- Review architectural shop drawings, material submissions, samples, and technical proposals for compliance with project requirements.
- Coordinate with structural, civil, MEP, landscape, and interior design teams to resolve design and construction interface issues.
- Evaluate requests for information, technical queries, and proposed architectural modifications.
- Support the review of value engineering proposals while maintaining design quality and functional requirements.
- Provide technical recommendations to resolve architectural challenges encountered during construction.
Quality Assurance and Compliance
- Ensure architectural works comply with approved quality plans, project specifications, and contract requirements.
- Review inspection reports, material approvals, and testing records related to architectural elements.
- Monitor implementation of inspection and test plans for architectural construction activities.
- Identify non-conformities and ensure corrective and preventive actions are effectively implemented.
- Participate in quality audits and compliance reviews to maintain project quality standards.
Materials and Finishes Management
- Review and assess architectural materials, finishes, fixtures, and product submissions for compliance with project standards.
- Verify installation of finishes and materials against approved mock-ups and sample boards.
- Monitor storage, handling, and installation practices to ensure material quality is maintained.
- Ensure consistency of architectural finishes throughout the project.
- Support selection reviews and approval processes for architectural materials and finishes where required.
Site Inspection and Progress Monitoring
- Conduct regular site inspections to assess construction progress, workmanship quality, and compliance with approved designs.
- Monitor contractor schedules related to architectural works and identify potential risks or delays.
- Verify completion and readiness of architectural works prior to inspections and handover stages.
- Track project milestones and report progress against approved construction programs.
- Assist in snagging, de-snagging, and final inspection activities.
Stakeholder Coordination
- Liaise with Client representatives, contractors, consultants, and project teams on architectural matters.
- Participate in progress meetings, design coordination meetings, and site inspections.
- Support resolution of site-related technical issues affecting architectural works.
- Coordinate with QA/QC, HSE, and engineering teams to ensure compliance with project requirements.
- Maintain effective communication with stakeholders to ensure successful project delivery.
Reporting and Documentation
- Prepare daily, weekly, and monthly reports covering architectural progress, inspections, and compliance status.
- Maintain records of site inspections, technical reviews, approvals, and quality observations.
- Review contractor reports and verify the accuracy of architectural work progress and completion status.
- Document non-conformances, corrective actions, design clarifications, and site instructions.
- Ensure all architectural documentation is properly maintained and available for audits, reviews, and project closeout.
About you
Qualifications
- Bachelor's Degree in Architecture or a related discipline from a recognized university.
- Master's Degree in Architecture, Urban Design, or Construction Management is preferred.
- Professional registration or architectural licensure is desirable.
- Membership in a recognized architectural or engineering professional body is preferred.
- Additional certifications related to construction supervision, project management, or quality management are advantageous.
Experience Requirements
- Minimum 8-12 years of professional experience in architectural design and construction supervision.
- Minimum 5 years of experience on site supervision consultancy projects involving major building developments.
- Proven experience in large-scale buildings, convention centers, hotels, resorts, and mixed-use developments.
- Strong experience in architectural finishes, facade systems, fit-out works, and building envelope construction.
- Previous GCC experience, particularly within Saudi Arabia, is highly desirable.
Technical Competencies
- Strong knowledge of architectural design principles, construction methodologies, and building systems.
- Thorough understanding of building codes, accessibility requirements, fire and life safety standards, and construction regulations.
- Experience in reviewing shop drawings, material submissions, architectural specifications, and technical documentation.
- Knowledge of facade systems, interior finishes, building envelope technologies, and fit-out construction.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, AutoCAD, Revit, BIM platforms, and other architectural software applications.
Behavioral Competencies
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
- Excellent analytical, coordination, and problem-solving abilities.
- High attention to detail and commitment to architectural quality and design excellence.
- Ability to work effectively within multidisciplinary project teams.
- Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities.
Rewards & benefits
Explore the rewards and benefits that help you thrive – at every stage of your life and your career.
This includes:
- Tax-free salary.
- Life insurance coverage.
- Medical insurance.
- Annual leave balance.
- Company gratuity scheme.
- Discretionary bonus program.
- Annual flight contribution.
- Transportation & housing allowances.
- Employee Wellbeing Program: 24/7 access to specialists in finance, legal matters, family care, personal health, fitness, and nutrition.
Seize every opportunity to sharpen your skills, expand your expertise, and be recognized for the impact you make.

ROLE PURPOSE
The aim is to state the overall significance of the job from the organization’s perspective.
The role exists to design, build, evaluate, and deploy applied AI solutions, including LLM-based workflows, vision-language models, and autonomous agents, that turn business use cases into reliable production capabilities. It selects the simplest effective design, grounds every decision in rigorous evaluation against real success criteria, and ensures solutions meet latency, cost, safety, and governance requirements. The role collaborates with Product, Engineering, Infrastructure, and ODC teams to deliver secure, scalable, and policy-compliant AI solutions.
KEY ACCOUNTABILITIES & ACTIVITIES
This section describes the principal outputs required from the job.
Key Accountabilities
Key Activities
- AI Use Case Scoping & Prototyping
- Translate business use cases into well-defined AI tasks with clear success metrics, selecting the simplest design that meets the required bar, whether a single model call, a fixed workflow, or an autonomous agent.
- Build prototypes using LLMs and vision-language models to validate technical feasibility on real data.
- Agent Architecture & Tooling
- Design agent architectures and the tools they use, including MCP servers, with clear interfaces, descriptions, and error messages that models can use reliably.
- Build memory and state-handling mechanisms, and determine when to split work across sub-agents, so that agents remain on track across long, multi-step tasks.
- Context Engineering & Model Adaptation
- Engineer what goes into the model's context, including retrieval, prompt structure, and compaction strategies for long-running tasks.
- Fine-tune and adapt models (SFT, LoRA, task-specific heads) where prompting and retrieval fall short, and justify the associated cost with evaluation results.
- AI Evaluation & Benchmarking
- Build evaluation datasets and automated evaluation harnesses from the outset of every project.
- Define metrics tied to real success criteria, such as accuracy, error severity, latency, and cost, rather than relying solely on public benchmarks.
- Evaluate agents on full trajectories as well as final answers, and design quantitative benchmarks to compare harness configurations on large, multi-step tasks.
- Error Analysis & Continuous Improvement
- Conduct error analysis to identify failure modes, and drive systematic improvements to models, prompts, and harnesses.
- Share findings, reusable components, and known model gaps with the product team to inform solution and roadmap decisions.
- Inference & Production Deployment
- Define and build inference pipelines, selecting the serving setup, batching, quantization, and caching approaches required to meet latency and cost targets.
- Deploy models and agents to production, and monitor quality, drift, cost, and step-by-step agent behavior once live.
- AI Safety, Guardrails & Access Control
- Implement guardrails against hallucination, prompt injection, and unsafe outputs, and document known limitations.
- Scope agent permissions and sandboxing, and enforce human approval for high-impact actions.
- Policies, Processes & Procedures
- Follow all relevant departmental policies, processes, standard operating procedures, and instructions so that work is carried out in a controlled and consistent manner.
- Comply with all relevant safety, quality, and environmental management policies, procedures, and controls to ensure a healthy and safe work environment.
- Information Security
- Comply with all relevant information security practices and standards to ensure data integrity and confidentiality.
JOB SPECIFICATIONS
Academic and professional qualifications
- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Artificial Intelligence, Data Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field.
- Professional certifications in Machine Learning, Generative AI, MLOps, or Cloud Computing are considered an advantage.
Years and Nature of Experience
- 2–4 years of relevant experience in applied AI/ML engineering, LLM application development, agentic systems, model evaluation, or AI solution deployment.

Inventory Planning & Analysis

- Analyze inventory trends, aging, slow-moving inventory, excess and obsolete (E&O) stock, and inventory turnover performance.
- Identify opportunities to improve inventory efficiency and working capital performance.
- Support inventory reconciliation activities and inventory performance reviews.
Business & Financial Analysis
- Support inventory-related financial reporting, inventory valuation, provisions, adjustments, and inventory control activities.
- Perform variance analysis against budget, forecast, and POR targets to identify performance gaps and business risks.
- Investigate operational and financial variances and provide meaningful insights to management.
- Collect, validate, and analyze business and operational data to identify trends, opportunities, and improvement areas.
- Develop analysis and recommendations to support informed business decisions.
Reporting & KPI Management
- Prepare and maintain inventory, operational, and business performance reports.
- Monitor key performance indicators including inventory value, inventory turnover (ITO), inventory accuracy, shortages, aging, and E&O inventory.
- Develop dashboards and management reports using ERP and business data.
- Provide regular updates and business insights to leadership teams.
Process Improvement & Cross-Functional Support
- Identify opportunities to improve reporting, data quality, automation, and operational processes.
- Support continuous improvement initiatives focused on inventory management and business performance.
- Collaborate with Finance, Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Logistics, Sales, Customer Service, and other functions to improve operational effectiveness.
- Support business planning, forecasting, and operational review processes.

- You communicate insights effectively and influence data-driven decisions.

GSK Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting Vision 2030 and the Saudi Arabian National Agenda including Saudization in line with the hiring and the training and development of Saudi National capability.
GSK Saudi Arabia is committed to supporting Vision 2030 and the Saudi Arabian National Agenda including Saudization in line with the hiring and the training and development of Saudi National capability.

The Financial Analyst will be responsible for supporting end-to-end reporting, tracking, and monitoring of SG&A spend. This includes monthly tracking of Advertising & Promotion (A&P) /Scientific Engagement (SE) spend activity by category, aligning with business and medical functions on YTD/YTG spend, with gap/phasing analysis. The role will involve working closely with the Close & Control (C&C) HUB during the ME closing and supporting the FBP in managing sign-off commentaries with the Planning HUB.
The role will also support the FBP during the monthly close and control activities, primarily related to capturing accurate SG&A by ensuring strong alignment with the C&C HUB. This will ensure completeness of accruals and accuracy of numbers with respect to spend allocation across business units.

Reporting and Analysis:
- Supervising close and control activities on profit and loss, monitoring budget vs actual P&L and submitting commentaries to regional teams.
- Providing visibility to the management on performance and spend by providing monthly and adhoc financial reports per requirement.
- Process improvement initiatives on all reporting and system automation to minimize manual work and efficient reporting that support decision making
Business Partnering:
- Carrying out all ancillary planning activities including and not limited to plan phasing (calendarization), exchange and cost flips, submission of plan in financial planning system, preparing GEM offline templates and presentations.
- Support Senior finance partner (SFP) in Core commercial cycle (CCC) with preparing summary for movements Vs. last cycles for SFP & FD ensuring active participation of finance by bringing in stock position, YTD / YTG growth, capturing market dynamics for competitive analysis etc.
- Tracking actual Gross-to-Net (G2N) reflections with focus analysis of variance Vs. plan and forecast (CCC)
- Reviewing SG&A aiming to make recommendations for cost savings.
- Supporting management / business units in provision of financials pertaining to business needs.
- Supporting and at times lead commercial initiatives to bring in operational efficiencies in SG&A.
- Be hands-on with analytical tools (Power BI etc.) to support core business team with data points and leads to action accordingly.
Why you?

We are looking for professionals with these required skills to achieve our goals:
- Saudi National.
- Bachelor’s degree of accounting or finance is required.

- Preferred Finance qualification: SOCPA/CA/ACCA/CPA/CFA/CMA/CIMA.
- 1-3 years of corporate finance and/or Big 4 experience required.
- Experience in the pharmaceutical industry is preferred.
- Advanced excel and power point skills.
- Written and spoken fluency in English and Arabic.
- The Candidate Must be Located in Riyadh.
Interpersonal skills
- Clear Communication: Strong verbal, written, and listening skills.
- Teamwork: Collaborative and goal oriented.
- Conflict Resolution: Diplomatic and empathetic.
- Adaptability: Flexible and relationship focused.
Essential Skills and Abilities:
- Understanding of commercial operations, reporting, IFRS, auditing, FP&A and business partnering.

jobs.description:
The role involves extracting data from technical platforms, verifying its quality, and analyzing it to create clear, formal reports that support performance monitoring and decision-making. This position combines analytical expertise with proficient Arabic writing skills, as well as a deep understanding of data requirements and coordination with the technical team.
• Building a structured reporting framework for governmental and quasi-governmental entities creatively.
- Identifying the reporting needs of the relevant stakeholders, documenting metrics, filters, classifications, and required delivery timelines.
• Extracting, organizing, and linking data sources within established parameters, identifying discrepancies, redundancies, and conflicts, and documenting their resolution while preserving original data integrity.
• Analyzing surveys and performance results, calculating metrics based on established formulas, and verifying alignment with platform outcomes while interpreting variances.
• Preparing regular and ad-hoc reports, schedules, and visuals, formulating results and actionable recommendations based on data, with clear definitions of the analysis scope and limits.
• Translating analytical needs into clear requirements for the technical team, covering fields, relationships, and calculation rules, ensuring that generated outputs meet the required standards.

Skills
• Experience in preparing reports for governmental and quasi-governmental entities.

- Creating Power BI dashboards for metrics and data modeling, using SQL for data retrieval and validation; experience in data processing using Python or similar tools is preferred.

jobs.title: Inverto | Manager - Digital, Data & AI
jobs.summary: At Inverto Riyadh, we are revolutionizing procurement and supply chain management with cutting-edge digital and AI solutions. We seek a Manager to lead transformative projects that deliver measurable value. This role offers the opportunity to shape the future of our clients' technological landscape while growing your expertise in a dynamic environment. If you are passionate about data and AI, this is your chance to make a significant impact.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At Inverto Riyadh, we’re shaping the future of procurement and supply chain, and we’re doing it with ambition, pace, and purpose. Backed by BCG and driven by our own entrepreneurial spirit, we work globally with market-leading clients to deliver strategies that make businesses stronger.
Our people are at the heart of that impact. We’re experts in our field, and we don’t stand still. We grow our capabilities, expand our offering, and scale our global presence together. Our success opens new doors for everyone here, and we make sure that growth is shared. Over the last few years, we've made big investments in our ability to bring digital and AI-based tools to our clients, including a center of excellence focused on the Digital, Data & AI topic.
As we build and expand our existing team of Digital, Data & AI experts, we’re looking for individuals who bring data, digital tools, and AI methods into real consulting projects that create measurable value in procurement and supply chain management. If you want to make a tangible difference, build lasting client relationships, and shape what comes next - we’d love to have you with us.
What You'll Do
In the Manager role in Digital, Data, and AI, you won’t just gather insights - you’ll turn them into action. You’ll actively work with clients to implement our digital and AI-based solutions in real world contexts to help clients unlock value and shape their technological future.
You won’t just execute - you’ll shape direction. You’ll lead stakeholder conversations, translate workshop insights into clear sourcing strategies, and deliver recommendations that enable confident, business-critical decisions.
As part of a fast-growing practice and an even faster-growing center of excellence, you’ll have the space to shape your journey. Whether you’re looking to deepen your expertise, explore new industries, or take the next step in your consulting career, we’ll support you with tailored development and real responsibility.
This is your opportunity to lead from the front, grow with purpose, and shape what’s next - alongside a team that shares your drive.
As part of a high-growth company, with accelerated opportunities you will be responsible for:
- Lead and deliver strategic Data & AI engagements. Own end-to-end delivery of advanced analytics and AI projects across procurement and supply chain use cases. Oversee workstreams involving data transformation, predictive modeling, automation, and GenAI applications. Manage complex stakeholder environments, guide delivery teams, and ensure outcomes are aligned with client objectives.
- Engage with digital, IT, and business leadership. Prepare and lead senior client meetings, steering committees, and workshops. Translate complex data and AI concepts into clear, actionable recommendations that drive measurable business impact.
- Turn data into decisions. Lead the design and execution of analytical solutions - ranging from data pipelines and dashboards to predictive models and AI-enabled tools. Synthesize insights from large, complex datasets and build robust, data-backed business cases to support transformation initiatives.
- Shape the evolution of Data Analytics & AI. Drive the development of new digital and AI offerings, reusable assets, and scalable solutions. Contribute innovative ideas on how emerging technologies (e.g., GenAI, automation, advanced analytics) can create value in procurement and supply chain.
- Contribute to winning new work. Play a key role in business development by contributing to proposals, client pitches, and opportunity assessments. Bring subject-matter expertise in data, analytics, and AI to shape compelling go-to-market narratives and tailored client solutions.
- Support and scale expertise. Act as a mentor and coach for junior team members. Lead project teams, provide guidance on technical and analytical approaches, and ensure high-quality, consistent delivery across engagements.
- Build and maintain knowledge assets. Lead the creation and refinement of internal tools, code libraries, benchmarks, and best practices. Strengthen the firm’s data and AI knowledge base to enable faster, insight-driven decision making.
- Shape our internal community. Take ownership of roles within the Data, Analytics & AI community - supporting recruitment, capability building, training initiatives, and the continued growth of the practice.
What You'll Bring
- 5-6+ years of professional experience in data analytics, AI, or digital consulting, with a strong track record of delivering client-facing projects.
- Bachelor’s degree from an accredited university (Master’s preferred) in a relevant field (e.g., Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Economics, or similar).
- Proven ability to lead client engagements, manage teams, and drive project outcomes in data and analytics contexts.
- Strong experience working with data analysis, visualization, and transformation tools (e.g., SQL, Power BI, Excel), combined with hands-on expertise in Python for analytics, automation, or AI workflows.
- Experience with cloud platforms and/or modern data ecosystems.
- Practical exposure to AI and GenAI technologies (e.g., LLMs, APIs, retrieval-based systems, or workflow orchestration tools) and their business applications.
- Ability to translate complex business problems—particularly in procurement and supply chain—into scalable analytics and AI solutions.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to bridge technical and business audiences.
- Results-driven mindset with a proactive, ownership-oriented approach.
- Business-fluent written and spoken English.
- Willingness to travel based on client and project needs.
- An entrepreneurial, collaborative mindset with a passion for innovation and team development.
- Consulting mindset and behaviors: independence, structured thinking, clear communication of insights, and the confidence to influence clients and stakeholders.
- Results-oriented mindset with a high level of personal accountability.
- Willingness to travel to work with clients and Inverto teams. At times, this role will require significant travel to client sites. The amount of travel will depend on client needs and nature of projects.
- An authentic, entrepreneurial spirit that thrives through team collaboration.
Who You'll Work With
- Talented, highly driven colleagues with deep expertise in procurement, tech sourcing, and related fields.
- Entrepreneurial thinkers with a strong growth mindset and passion for procurement and supply chain.
- Teammates who bring energy, focus, and real-world value-creation experience.
- Authentic, collaborative people who elevate the team and support each other to succeed.

Mechanical Design Checker:
- Perform design verification and validation of traditional Mechanical 2D Drawings as well as “Model-Based” Design TDPs.

- Schedule orders in line with delivery commitments and production requirements.
- Release work orders based on production capacity, WIP levels, inventory status, and customer priorities.

- Monitor production flow and maximize throughput across manufacturing operations.
- Drive service level performance by optimizing planning and lead-time management activities.
- Support planning activities for MRO and project orders to ensure successful execution.

- Collaborate with Engineering, Production, Quality, Stores, and Customer Service teams to support effective order execution.
- Coordinate BOM changes and resolve planning-related engineering issues.
- Liaise with internal stakeholders to ensure customer specifications and requirements are achieved.
- Plan and coordinate customer inspections throughout the manufacturing process.
- Maintain visibility of capacity constraints across stores, assembly, paint, quality, and packing operations.

- Support inventory optimization initiatives, including inventory turnover (ITO), safety stock, excess and obsolete inventory management, and material planning.
- Contribute to inventory performance improvement programs and cost-saving initiatives.
- Identify production bottlenecks and recommend process improvements.
- Support operational excellence and continuous improvement initiatives.

- Late Backlog Reports
- Root Cause Analysis (RCA)
- On-Time Delivery (OTD)
- Inventory Bridges
- Inventory Turnover (ITO)
- POR Phasing Reports
- Provide planning insights and recommendations to support business decisions.
- Support business unit initiatives to improve operational efficiency and profitability.
- Perform additional duties as assigned by management.
Who You Are
- You are action-oriented and focused on achieving results.
- You demonstrate strong planning and organizational capabilities.
- You collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams.
- You communicate clearly and professionally with stakeholders.
- You adapt quickly to changing priorities and operational demands.
- You demonstrate integrity, accountability, and strong attention to detail.
- You continuously seek opportunities to improve processes and performance.

- Bachelor's Degree in Engineering or a related technical discipline.
- 1-3 years of experience in planning, manufacturing, operations, supply chain, or related functions.
- Understanding of production planning and manufacturing processes.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
- Knowledge of ERP systems and manufacturing workflows.
- Good communication and stakeholder management capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced environment.

- Experience in manufacturing, valve industry, or industrial production environments.
- Knowledge of inventory management, supply chain planning, and production scheduling.
- Experience with ERP-based planning systems.
- Familiarity with inventory optimization and operational performance metrics.

jobs.description:
WSP is seeking a Senior Mechanical Engineer - Infrastructure to join our Transport & Infrastructure team in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia. The role will support the design and delivery of multidisciplinary infrastructure and masterplan projects, with a particular focus on district cooling and chilled water networks, gas distribution systems, mechanical utilities, and pump station interfaces.
The successful candidate will produce engineering calculations, models, technical reports, specifications, tender documentation, and authority submission packages. Working under the direction of senior technical leaders, the Senior Mechanical Engineer will coordinate with clients, authorities, contractors, and internal disciplines to deliver safe, sustainable, buildable, and cost-effective engineering solutions.
Responsibilities:
Mechanical Infrastructure Design
• Develop mechanical infrastructure designs, calculations, specifications, schedules, reports, and drawings for district cooling, chilled water, gas distribution, and associated utility systems.
• Undertake concept, feasibility, preliminary, and detailed design activities for infrastructure and masterplan developments.
• Support cooling strategy studies, including district cooling and decentralised cooling options, considering technical, commercial, constructability, sustainability, and operational factors.
• Support gas supply studies and option assessments, including LPG, SNG, and other suitable solutions based on project requirements.
• Develop designs for gas farms, pressure regulating stations, distribution pipework, and associated mechanical infrastructure.
• Contribute to mechanical design interfaces for pump stations and other infrastructure facilities.
Modelling & Technical Analysis
• Undertake hydraulic modelling and engineering analysis for chilled water and gas networks using appropriate industry software.
• Prepare design calculations, equipment selections, technical assessments, and option comparison reports.
• Review modelling outputs and coordinate findings with civil, utilities, electrical, structural, and masterplanning teams.
Codes, Standards & Approvals
• Apply the Saudi Building Code, applicable Saudi authority requirements, Civil Defense requirements, NFPA, IGEM, ASHRAE, and relevant international standards.
• Prepare authority submission documentation and support the resolution of technical comments through to approval.
• Remain current with Saudi regulations, industry standards, emerging technologies, and good practice for mechanical infrastructure.
Project Delivery & Coordination
• Coordinate with multidisciplinary teams to deliver integrated infrastructure solutions.
• Prepare and review technical reports, design packages, tender documents, performance specifications, and procurement information.
• Review contractor shop drawings, material submittals, and technical queries during construction support stages.
• Attend progress meetings and technical workshops with clients, consultants, contractors, and authorities.
• Maintain accurate project records and technical documentation, and deliver assigned work to agreed programme, budget, and quality requirements.
Quality, Safety & Sustainability
• Follow project QA/QC procedures and undertake checking of calculations, drawings, reports, and specifications.
• Identify technical risks and support the development of practical mitigation measures.
• Develop solutions that consider safety, sustainability, cost, constructability, maintainability, and whole-life performance.
Team & Client Support
• Provide clear technical updates to project managers, discipline leads, and clients.
• Support and guide graduate and junior engineers, sharing technical knowledge and good practice.
• Contribute to design schedules, resource planning, fee estimates, and technical inputs to bids where required.
Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Mechanical Engineering or a related engineering discipline.
- Minimum 8+ years of post-graduate experience in mechanical engineering, preferably within an international engineering consultancy or infrastructure design environment.
- Demonstrable experience designing mechanical infrastructure systems, particularly district cooling/chilled water and gas distribution networks.
- Experience supporting infrastructure, utilities, land development, or masterplan projects in Saudi Arabia or the wider Middle East is highly desirable.
- Knowledge of the Saudi Building Code, Saudi authority requirements, Civil Defense requirements, NFPA, IGEM, ASHRAE, and relevant international standards.
- Experience with hydraulic modelling tools for chilled water and gas networks. Familiarity with Bentley WaterGEMS, SISHYD/GasWorks, FLUIDIT, or comparable software is advantageous.
- Experience preparing design calculations, technical reports, specifications, tender documentation, and authority approval packages.
- Ability to review shop drawings and material submittals and provide construction-stage technical support.
- Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to work effectively in multidisciplinary and multicultural teams.
- Professional membership or progress toward chartership or equivalent registration is desirable.

- Experience with proposal development.

jobs.description:
About the Group
We are a diversified business group operating in wholesale trade, import and export, alongside the hospitality, tourism, and industrial sectors. The group comprises four subsidiaries in trade, several hotel establishments, and a factory, and we aim to attract skilled professionals who contribute to the development of our business and achieve sustainable growth.
Job Objective
To lead and manage accounting operations and daily financial activities, ensuring the accuracy and integrity of records, reports, and financial statements, and preparing consolidated financial statements for the company and its subsidiaries or branches, while developing an effective costing system and analyzing profitability to support management in making sound financial and operational decisions.
Responsibilities and Duties
- Direct supervision of the accounting team, task distribution, and reviewing the quality of financial outputs while ensuring compliance with specified deadlines.
- Manage the complete accounting cycle; from recording daily entries and reviewing documentation to preparing monthly and annual financial statements and closures.
- Review general ledgers, client and supplier accounts, bank accounts, contracts, loans, inventory, and fixed assets, and address discrepancies and variances.
- Prepare and review periodic and annual financial statements in accordance with accounting standards and established financial policies.
- Prepare consolidated financial statements for the company and its subsidiaries and branches.
- Execute intercompany transactions, including assets, sales, purchases, expenses, and unrealized profits.
- Prepare consolidation files and necessary adjustments, coordinating with management and subsidiaries to obtain timely financial data.
- Develop and implement a costing system that aligns with the nature of the company's activities, including designing templates for direct and indirect costs, fixed and variable costs.
- Identify and track costs for production centers and services, ensuring accurate allocation and distribution based on fair and consistent bases.
- Prepare product or service cost reports and analyze profit margins based on activity, branch, or client needs.
- Monitor and analyze cost variances between standard and actual costs, identifying reasons and recommending corrective actions.

Reporting directly to the Regional HSE leadership, the HSE Manager will be responsible for implementing and maintaining the organization's HSE standards, ensuring compliance with local regulations and corporate requirements, and fostering a strong safety culture across offices, projects, accommodations, and transportation operations. The role requires close collaboration with operational, logistics, project, and client stakeholders to drive continuous improvement in health, safety, wellbeing, and environmental performance while supporting the successful delivery of AtkinsRéalis projects and business objectives.
Your role

About you

jobs.title: HSSE Manager | Al-Futtaim Automotive - BYD | KSA | Riyadh
jobs.summary: The HSSE Manager will spearhead the development and enhancement of Health, Safety, Security, and Environment programs across Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD operations in Saudi Arabia. This role is pivotal in ensuring compliance with KSA regulations and fostering a safety-first culture, thereby protecting the workforce and brand reputation across multiple sites. The position demands a proactive approach to risk management, incident investigation, and emergency preparedness, all aimed at supporting business growth and operational continuity.
jobs.description:
Overview of the Role
The HSSE Manager will lead the development, implementation, and continuous improvement of Health, Safety, Security, and Environment programs across all Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD operations in the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role ensures full compliance with KSA regulatory frameworks (Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS where applicable, SASO, and Environmental Authorities) and aligns operational practices with Al-Futtaim Group HSSE governance standards. Reporting into the Head of Government Relations & HSSE, the position carries direct accountability for protecting the workforce, customers, assets, and brand reputation across BYD showrooms, workshops, parts warehouses, and corporate sites in Riyadh, Jeddah, Dammam, and the wider KSA dealer network. The role is critical to enabling business growth by ensuring uninterrupted operations, securing all statutory certifications, and embedding a strong safety-first culture across the BYD KSA footprint.
What You Will Do
Loss Prevention & Risk Management
- Drive hazard identification and gap reporting across all assigned BYD KSA sites through scheduled inspections, risk assessments, and field walkthroughs.
- Reduce preventable incidents through structured corrective and preventive action plans, ensuring all findings are tracked to closure on the Site Compliance & Hazard Tracker.
- Conduct full-cycle incident investigations for all medium and high-severity events within 24 hours of occurrence and ensure root-cause analysis is documented in the HSSE IMS.
- Maintain the Automotive Risk Register with up-to-date hazard observations, control measures, and residual risk ratings.
- Achieve and sustain a minimum 80% compliance score across all HSSE Compliance Audits for assigned sites.
Regulatory & Statutory Compliance
- Ensure full alignment with all KSA HSSE legislation including Saudi Civil Defense regulations, MHRSD Occupational Safety & Health requirements, HCIS standards where applicable, SASO, and Environmental requirements set by the National Centre for Environmental Compliance.
- Secure and renew all statutory permits including Civil Defense Safety Certificates, Environmental Clearance, and Municipal HSSE clearances for trade license renewal.
- Stay current with KSA regulatory developments and proactively implement operational adjustments to safeguard the business from violations, financial penalties, and operational disruption.
- Ensure zero notices of violation across all assigned sites and no pending high-risk audit recommendations beyond 90 days.
- Represent Al-Futtaim Automotive – BYD in regulatory inspections, OEM HSSE audits, and third-party assessments.
Emergency Preparedness & Response
- Develop and maintain site-specific emergency response plans covering fire, structural collapse, chemical and gas exposure, sandstorms, flooding, medical emergencies, and pandemic events.
- Plan and supervise a minimum of two emergency evacuation drills per site per year, ensuring all findings drive procedural improvement.
- Ensure all sites comply with Civil Defense requirements for trained First Aiders and Fire Wardens, proportionate to headcount and license category.
- Maintain full operational readiness of fire alarm, suppression, and life-safety systems through continuous monitoring, vendor coordination, and escalation.
- Lead the HSSE response for major business events, product launches, ceremonies, and customer activations across the KSA network.
Safety Culture & Behavioral Standards
- Lead structured monthly Safety Committee meetings at every assigned site, ensuring documented minutes, agreed actions, and audit-ready evidence.
- Embed visible safety standards across all facilities including signage, PPE compliance, LOTO procedures, safe pathways, evacuation maps, and emergency communication boards.
- Champion continuous workforce awareness through toolbox talks, safety alerts, behavioral observation programs, and structured campaigns in partnership with HR and Training.
- Develop and maintain Safe Work Procedures (SWPs) for all hazardous tasks, machinery, and operations — reviewed annually and visibly displayed at each workstation.
ISO & Management System Accreditation
- Lead BYD KSA operations through ISO 45001 (Occupational Health & Safety), ISO 14001 (Environmental Management), and other relevant international certifications.
- Maintain documented HSSE management systems aligned with Al-Futtaim Group standards, OEM (BYD) HSSE requirements, and international benchmarks.
- Coordinate with internal compliance teams and external certification bodies to ensure successful certification, surveillance, and re-certification audits.
- Drive continuous improvement of HSSE policies, procedures, and standard operating practices in line with evolving global and local standards.
Team Leadership & Development
- Lead, develop, and supervise HSSE Officers and the field HSSE team across the BYD KSA dealer network.
- Set clear performance objectives, conduct structured monthly performance reviews, and manage gaps through formal improvement frameworks.
- Build technical capability across the team through structured training, certification pathways, and exposure to operational HSSE challenges.
- Maintain audit-ready records of team coverage, site visit frequency, attendance, and operational deployment.
- Drive Saudization of the HSSE function in line with MHRSD requirements and Al-Futtaim workforce planning targets.
Reporting, Analytics & Stakeholder Management
- Deliver regular HSSE performance dashboards, audit summaries, leading and lagging indicators, and incident trend analysis to senior leadership and HRBP.
- Partner with Aftersales, Sales, Logistics, Facilities, HR, and Government Relations leadership to integrate HSSE priorities into operational decision-making.
- Provide executive-level visibility on HSSE risk exposure, mitigation progress, and statutory certification status.
- Support business strategy reviews with credible HSSE intelligence on regulatory shifts, market practices, and operational risk.
Skills
Required Skills to Be Successful
- Strong technical command of HSSE management systems, risk assessment methodology, and incident investigation.
- Proven leadership and team development capability across multi-site distributed operations.
- Clear working knowledge of the KSA HSSE regulatory landscape — Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS, SASO, and Environmental Authorities.
- Confident stakeholder management with senior business leaders, OEM principals, and government authorities.
- Excellent reporting, documentation, and audit-readiness discipline.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root-cause investigation capability.
- High personal presence and field credibility — comfortable spending significant time on the shop floor and at site.
- Effective communication in English and Arabic, with the ability to engage workforces of mixed nationalities.
- Composure under pressure and strong decision-making during emergency events.
- Proactive, self-driven, and committed to building a visible safety-first culture.
What Qualifies You for the Role
- Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Occupational Health & Safety, Environmental Sciences, or a related discipline.
- NEBOSH International General Certificate (IGC) is mandatory; NEBOSH International Diploma is strongly preferred.
- IOSH Managing Safely certification is mandatory.
- Additional certifications such as ISO 45001 / ISO 14001 Lead Auditor, OSHA 30, or NFPA equivalents are highly preferred.
- Minimum 6 to 12 years of progressive HSSE experience, including at least 3 to 5 years in a managerial capacity.
- Demonstrable experience in automotive retail, dealer operations, large-scale workshops, parts/logistics warehousing, or comparable multi-site industries.
- Direct working exposure to KSA regulatory frameworks — Saudi Civil Defense, MHRSD, HCIS (where applicable), SASO, and Environmental Authorities.
- Proven track record of leading ISO 45001 and ISO 14001 certification and surveillance audits to successful outcomes.
- Strong working knowledge of HSSE management systems, incident reporting platforms, and analytics tools.
- Bilingual proficiency in Arabic and English (mandatory).
- Valid KSA driving license and willingness to travel across all KSA regions on a regular basis, including weekends when required.
