jobs.description:
Company Description
Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).
Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.
Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.
Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.
Job Description
Portfolio 3 is searching to build out it’s Operations team with a new Operations Manager to join the team and help strengthen our foundation. Heading into it’s 3rd year, the portfolio is looking to build an it’s initial success with CPHI Middle East, Umrah & Ziyarah Forum, and Saudi Maritime & Logistics Congress. With some more exciting projects on the horizon you could be one of the key drivers in the next stage of bringing amazing experiences to, and forging memorable brands in, The Kingdom.
As Portfolio 3 is building and growing we are looking for someone to come and help specifically, but not limited to, the delivery of:
-
The expanding Umrah & Ziyarah Forum ecosystem
-
The evolving Innovation Driven Water Sustainability (IDWS) event after a successful 1st year.
The Operations Manager is responsible for the professional operational delivery of their allocated events; features and projects. You will ensure that all are delivered to the highest possible standards and to the satisfaction of all parties involved consistently throughout the year.
Reporting to the Head & Senior Operations Managers, the Operations Manager will be responsible together with the Senior Operations Manager for implementing the EMEA Operations objectives. The intention is for the Operations Manager to eventually take full lead on running these streams, with High Level Ministry involvement and communication required.
The Operations Manager should lead by example and demonstrate a professional responsibility to the department at all times. Adding value to the Operations Department and Portfolio alike and helping others to build their knowledge and ability for the future of Tahaluf.
Operational Duties
-
Be the key point of contact for the show teams in all matters on your allocated shows, internal and external.
-
Accountability for setting, regular forecasting & achieving operational show budgets for allocated events.
-
Responsibility for successful show management and technical delivery of several physical and digital events throughout the year including features & fully undertaking all related tasks.
-
Manage production and implementation of show project plans ensuring all operational tasks are carried out on a timely basis according to individual project plans and within deadlines across all your events.
-

The Pastry Chef is responsible for preparing and producing a variety of high-quality pastries, desserts, cakes, breads, and other bakery products while maintaining excellent standards of taste, presentation, consistency, and food safety.
If you are passionate about pastry and baking and enjoy working in a dynamic hospitality environment, we invite you to join our team.
Primary Responsibilities:
• Prepare and produce a variety of pastries, cakes, desserts, breads, and bakery products according to hotel recipes and standards.

• Follow all food safety, hygiene, and health & safety procedures at all times.

• Coordinate with other kitchen sections to ensure timely preparation and smooth food service.
• Assist with special events, celebrations, weddings, buffets, and hotel functions when required.
• Support and guide Commis Chefs and junior pastry team members when required.
• Assist with the development of new pastry items, desserts, and creative presentations.
• Ensure all products meet the hotel's quality and presentation standards before being served.
• Maintain a professional appearance and wear the hotel uniform correctly at all times.
• Perform any additional duties assigned by the Executive Chef, Sous Chef, or Kitchen Management.
Requirements:
• Previous experience as a Pastry Chef or in a similar pastry/bakery position is preferred.
• Previous experience in a hotel, restaurant, bakery, or hospitality environment is an advantage.
• Good knowledge of pastry, baking, desserts, cakes, and bakery production.
• Good knowledge of food preparation, baking techniques, and pastry equipment.
• Good knowledge of food safety and hygiene standards.
• Strong attention to detail and commitment to product quality and presentation.
• Creative approach to pastry and dessert preparation.
• Ability to work efficiently in a fast-paced kitchen environment.
• Good communication and teamwork skills.
• Ability to work under pressure and manage multiple tasks during busy service periods.
• Ability to follow recipes and production schedules accurately.
• Flexibility to work shifts, including evenings, weekends, and public holidays.
• Ability to stand and work for long periods during production and service.
• Basic English communication skills are preferred.
• Culinary or pastry qualification, diploma, or relevant professional training is an advantage

Job Summary
The Talent Recruiter will support end-to-end recruitment activities across the Middle East & Africa (MEA) region. In this role, you will partner with hiring managers and HR colleagues to attract, engage, and hire talented individuals who contribute to Emerson's continued growth. You will leverage sourcing strategies, recruiting technologies, and market insights to deliver an inclusive and positive candidate experience while building strong talent pipelines for current and future hiring needs.
In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:
-
Manage full-cycle recruitment for assigned positions across MEA, ensuring an efficient and positive hiring experience.
-
Source and engage prospective candidates through Oracle Recruiting Cloud, LinkedIn Recruiter, job boards, referrals, and other sourcing channels.
-
Partner with hiring managers to understand job requirements and align recruitment strategies with business needs.
-
Conduct candidate screening, interviews, and assessments using structured and objective selection methods.
-
Maintain talent pipelines and candidate communities for recurring and critical positions.
-
Provide timely communication and updates to candidates, hiring managers, and HR stakeholders throughout the recruitment process.
-
Support inclusion, localization, and workforce planning initiatives across the region.
-
Utilize recruitment metrics and market intelligence to improve hiring effectiveness and decision-making.
-
Represent Emerson at career fairs, university events, and employer branding initiatives.
-
Ensure compliance with local employment regulations, company policies, and recruitment best practices.
-
Support internship, graduate, and early-career hiring programs as required.
-
Adhere to Emerson Health & Safety standards.
Who You Are:
You adapt your communication approach to effectively engage with different audiences and build productive relationships. You manage competing priorities while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail. You proactively identify solutions to challenges and remain effective in changing environments. You collaborate openly with others, foster trust, and contribute positively to shared goals and business outcomes.
For This Role, You Will Need:
-
Bachelor's degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, Psychology, or a related field.
-
5+ years of full-cycle recruitment experience in an agency, in-house, or blended recruiting environment.
-
Experience sourcing candidates through multiple channels and building talent pipelines.
-
Knowledge of recruitment processes, interviewing techniques, and candidate assessment methodologies.
-
Ability to manage multiple requisitions simultaneously in a fast-paced environment.
-
Strong communication, stakeholder management, and organizational skills.
-
Experience working with Applicant Tracking Systems (ATS) and recruitment technologies.
Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:
-
Experience using Oracle Recruiting Cloud or similar applicant tracking systems.
-
Familiarity with localization initiatives such as Saudization, Emiratization, or other regional workforce programs.
-
Experience recruiting across multiple countries within MEA.
-
Exposure to employer branding, campus recruitment, or graduate hiring programs.
Our Culture & Commitment to You!
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.

We provide medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, tuition reimbursement, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture prioritizes work-life balance and offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
Our training programs and initiatives focus on end-to-end development, from onboarding through senior leadership. We provide a wide range of development opportunities, including face-to-face and virtual training, mentorship, and coaching, project management, and on-the-job training.

Our Commitment to Our People
At Emerson, we are motivated by a spirit of collaboration that helps our diverse, multicultural teams across the world drive innovation that makes the world healthier, safer, smarter, and more sustainable. And we want you to join us in our bold aspiration.
We have built an engaged community of inquisitive, dedicated people who thrive knowing they are welcomed, trusted, celebrated, and empowered to solve the world’s most complex problems — for our customers, our communities, and the planet. You’ll contribute to this vital work while further developing your skills through our award-winning employee development programs. We are a proud corporate citizen in every city where we operate and are committed to our people, our communities, and the world at large. We take this responsibility seriously and strive to make a positive impact through every endeavor.
At Emerson, you’ll see firsthand that our people are at the center of everything we do. So, let’s go. Let’s think differently. Learn, collaborate, and grow. Seek opportunity. Push boundaries. Be empowered to make things better. Speed up to break through. Let’s go, together.

About the job IBM CLOUD PAK FOR INTEGRATION (CP4I) OPENSHIFT ADMINISTRATOR
Duncan & Ross is hiring an IBM CP4I OpenShift Administrator for a leading enterprise client in Riyadh. You'll own the deployment, security and day-to-day operation of the client's hybrid-cloud integration platform: IBM Cloud Pak for Integration running on Red Hat OpenShift, with a focus on high availability and automation.
What you'll do

- Design persistent storage (ODF/Ceph, Portworx, CSI), and run cluster upgrades, patching and node updates with zero downtime as the goal.
- Build monitoring dashboards, automate provisioning through GitOps, and troubleshoot cluster, storage and pod networking issues.

- A bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, IT or a related field.
- Hands-on experience administering production Red Hat OpenShift clusters.
- Practical experience deploying and operating IBM CP4I components.

- An understanding of enterprise integration patterns, message queuing and API lifecycle management.
- Composure and a structured approach when resolving production incidents.
- Fluent English, spoken and written.

- Platforms: OpenShift (RHOCP/OKD), Kubernetes, CoreOS, IBM CP4I, MQ, API Connect, ACE, Event Streams, DataPower
- Automation and CI/CD: Ansible, Terraform, ArgoCD, Helm, Kustomize, Tekton, Jenkins, GitLab CI/CD
- Monitoring: Prometheus, Grafana, OpenShift Logging, Sysdig
- Scripting: Bash, Python, oc, kubectl
- Storage: ODF, Ceph, Portworx, AWS EBS/EFS

jobs.summary: Elevate your career as a Senior HPC Systems Administrator at KAUST Supercomputing Laboratory, where you will manage a sophisticated HPC cluster of around 600 nodes. jobs.description:
Position Summary
We are seeking a highly motivated and skilled Senior HPC Systems Administrator to join the KAUST Supercomputing Laboratory (KSL). The successful candidate will be responsible for managing an HPC cluster of approximately 600 CPU and GPU nodes, HPC storage systems, InfiniBand and Ethernet networks, and day-to-day operational issues. The role provides broad support to researchers and end-users across computational science, engineering, big data analysis, and artificial intelligence/machine learning workloads.
Major Responsibilities – include but are not limited to -
- Provide timely and effective user support via telephone, walk-in, email, and ticketing system for all inquiry types while maintain high customer service standards.
- Install, configure, and manage HPC subsystems including compute nodes, high-performance storage systems, InfiniBand, Ethernet, and configuration management tools (e.g., Ansible, Puppet).
- Deploy and manage cluster management software, monitoring tools, and supporting services for operating HPC clusters.
- Install and administer the Slurm workload manager, manage QOS policies, accounts, accounting, and related automation scripts (Python and C++).
- Develop and maintain automation scripts in Bash and Python to streamline system administration tasks.
- Deploy and manage container environments (Singularity/Apptainer, Docker) for HPC workloads.
- Benchmark HPC system components like CPU, memory, InfiniBand, and storage periodically to ensure optimal performance and identify tuning opportunities across hardware, driver, and application layers.
- Enforce security best practices including node hardening, kernel patching, and compliance across all systems.
- Manage parallel file systems such as Lustre, GPFS, Weka, or Vast, including performance tuning and capacity planning.
- Directly support research activities in computational science, engineering, data analysis, and AI/ML by working closely with faculty, researchers, collaboration partners, and industrial partners in collaboration with application support teams.
- Develop software tools and utilities as needed to support research projects on cluster systems and subsystems.
- Drive proof-of-concept projects and technology evaluations end-to-end and research industry best practices and advocate system enhancements.
- Coordinate with vendors and third-party service providers to report and resolve issues in a timely manner.
- Develop and maintain user documentation, standard operating procedures, and training materials in the internal wiki.
- Stay at the forefront of HPC advancements through continuous learning, industry conferences, and professional collaboration, while driving benchmarking initiatives to inform future hardware procurement.
Competencies
- Expertise in supporting users of computational science and engineering, data analysis, and artificial intelligence applications and libraries in different HPC environments.
- Strong expertise in Linux system administration (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or CentOS) in large-scale HPC environments.
- Proficiency with HPC applications and programming models (Fortran, C/C++, Python, MPI, OpenMP, CUDA, OpenACC).
- Demonstrated track record of managing complex HPC systems, including parallel file systems, job schedulers, InfiniBand/Ethernet networks, and monitoring systems.
- Experience with configuration management tools (Ansible, Puppet, or equivalent).
- Familiarity with computational science, data analysis, and AI/ML applications and libraries used in HPC environments.
- Knowledge of project management principles and practices.
- Demonstrated ability to support research activities in a highly collaborative HPC environment.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and decision-making skills.
- Proactively identifies and implements system improvements; takes initiative and sees tasks through to closure.
- Ability to manage multiple concurrent projects and deliver high-quality results within deadlines.
- Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally with researchers, application teams, and vendors.
- Effective in multi-cultural, international work environments.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills in English, including the ability to prepare and deliver technical reports and presentations.
Qualifications
Education requirement, minimum:
Bachelor’s or master’s degree in computer science/engineering, Information Systems, or equivalent
Experience
Experience requirement, minimum:
- Five years of experience supporting large scale computing platforms and related subsystems.
- Experience troubleshooting complex hardware issues and documenting root cause analysis.
- Experience managing parallel storage systems (Lustre, GPFS, Weka, Vast, or similar).
- Experience benchmarking HPC system components (CPU, memory, InfiniBand, storage).
- Experience administering workload managers/schedulers (Slurm, LSF, or PBS).
- Strong Linux system administration experience (RHEL, Rocky Linux, or CentOS).
- Experience with configuration management tools such as Ansible or Puppet.
- Ability to coordinate with researchers, application support teams, and vendors to resolve complex issues and drive them to closure.
- Proven ability to collaborate cross-functionally and drive initiatives to completion.
- Familiarity with Kubernetes and container orchestration platforms would be desirable

You should also have a demonstrated ability to think strategically about business, products, and technical challenges.
As an Amazon Web Services (AWS) Sr. Manager, Solutions Architect you are joining a team that invests in your success by providing a comprehensive learning program. The AWS Solutions Architecture team provides an opportunity to work in an open environment that includes self-paced learning, instructor-led training, hands-on projects, and job shadowing opportunities to develop your knowledge of the AWS ecosystem of services and solutions. The ideal candidate has a curious mind, a thirst for knowledge, and a desire to understand how technology works. Hire, enable, and develop an industry-leading team of solutions architects

Contribute to AWS internal and customer-facing publications such as white-papers and blogs as a means of scaling your knowledge.
Act as a liaison between customers, service engineering teams, and support to address customer needs.

No two days look the same. You might start the morning reviewing a customer architecture with one of your SAs, then join a pipeline review with your Sales counterpart mid-morning. Over lunch you review a reference architecture your team is publishing, and in the afternoon you surface Ent. field patterns to an AWS service team to inform their next release. You close the day interviewing a candidate.
You lead a team of Solutions Architects covering Saudi customers, where needs range from first-cloud migrations to AI-powered architectures. jobs.title: Sorting Team Leader
jobs.summary: A pivotal role in logistics awaits, where expertise in sorting and team management will drive operational excellence. Responsibilities include developing sorting plans, optimizing workflows, and ensuring quality control while fostering a collaborative team environment. This position offers a unique opportunity to influence the future of supply chain logistics through innovative practices and strategic leadership.
jobs.description:
Who We Are
At JINGDONG Logistics (JD Logistics), part of JD.com, we are a leading technology-driven supply chain and logistics solutions provider under JD.com. Built on deep expertise in automation, smart fulfilment, and data intelligence, we operate end-to-end logistics services that empower businesses and enhance customer experience. Our integrated networks span warehouse management, line-haul transportation, last-mile delivery, bulky items logistics, cold chain, and cross-border operations, ensuring speed, reliability, and precision at every stage.
Our Global Reach
JINGDONG Logistics has developed one of the most extensive logistics infrastructures in the world, managing more than 3,600 warehouses with over 34 million square meters of space. Our Global Smart Supply Chain Network combines highly automated warehousing with robust international transportation solutions, enabling seamless cross-border movement. Today, we operate 130+ bonded, direct mail, and overseas warehouses across 23 countries and regions, supported by our global brands, JoyLogistics and JoyExpress, as we continue scaling JD.com’s international logistics footprint.
Learn more about who we are and what we do: https://www.jingdonglogistics.com/
What We Offer
Joining JD Logistics means helping shape the future of global supply chain and logistics. You’ll work with smart warehousing, autonomous delivery, and innovative technology that keeps goods moving worldwide. With a competitive salary, great locations, and a supportive, people-first culture, you’ll have the space to take on meaningful challenges, grow your skills, and make a real impact in a fast-evolving industry.
About The Team
You’ll be joining the JINGDONG Logistics team, which values collaboration, ownership, and a commitment to delivering high-quality results in a fast-paced, dynamic environment.
Task Allocation & Personnel Scheduling: Develop scientific sorting plans based on cargo volume and timeliness targets. Rationally allocate tasks among team members, coordinate equipment usage, ensure orderly sorting operations, and guarantee timely completion and dispatch of sorted goods.
Process Supervision & Optimization: Oversee the execution of sorting workflows, inspect compliance with operational standards, and promptly correct violations. Analyze operational bottlenecks, optimize sorting paths and methods, promote process standardization, and enhance overall sorting efficiency.
Exception Handling & Quality Control: Address anomalies during sorting, such as cargo damage or sorting errors, providing timely feedback and coordinating solutions. Conduct random inspections and verification of sorting quality to ensure accuracy and reduce error rates.
Team Management & Training: Manage the daily operations of the sorting team, organize training sessions to improve operational skills and safety awareness. Monitor team members' work status, foster a positive team atmosphere, and enhance team cohesion and execution.
Cross-Functional Collaboration: Work closely with loading/unloading, transportation, and other roles to ensure smooth handover of goods. Communicate and provide feedback promptly, collaboratively resolve interface issues between sorting and other operational stages, and ensure efficient end-to-end logistics flow.
At JINGDONG Logistics, we’re committed to building a diverse and inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. We’re proud to be an equal opportunity employer and make all employment decisions without regard to race, color, religion, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other protected characteristic.
Ready to apply?
Take the next step in your career, apply now and explore the opportunities we have to offer.

jobs.title: Compliance Officer
jobs.summary: As a Compliance Officer, you will play a crucial role in implementing and managing the compliance framework to meet SAMA regulatory requirements. Your responsibilities include conducting compliance monitoring, regulatory analysis, and risk assessments while providing advisory support to business functions. This position demands a proactive approach to ensure adherence to laws and internal policies, making it essential for maintaining the organization's integrity and reputation.
jobs.description:
As the Compliance Officer, you will support the effective implementation and ongoing management of the organization's compliance framework to ensure adherence to SAMA regulatory requirements, applicable laws, and internal policies. You will independently perform compliance monitoring, regulatory analysis, risk assessments, regulatory obligations tracking, and compliance reviews, while providing day-to-day advisory support to business functions.
Key Responsibilities
- Support the implementation and ongoing management of the organization's compliance framework in line with SAMA regulations and applicable regulatory requirements.
- Monitor SAMA circulars, regulatory updates, guidance, and relevant industry developments and assess their impact on the organization's activities.
- Conduct regulatory research and analysis and translate applicable requirements into practical compliance actions and internal requirements.
- Support the development, review, and maintenance of compliance policies, procedures, standards, and controls.
- Perform compliance monitoring and testing activities to assess adherence to regulatory requirements, policies, procedures, and established controls.
- Conduct compliance risk assessments and identify potential regulatory risks, control gaps, and areas requiring remediation.
- Maintain regulatory obligations trackers and monitor the implementation and completion of SAMA regulatory requirements across relevant business functions.
- Provide day-to-day compliance advisory support to business teams on SAMA regulatory requirements, policies, processes, and operational activities.
- Review products, services, processes, partnerships, and business initiatives to identify applicable compliance requirements and potential regulatory risks.
- Support the preparation, review, and submission of regulatory reports and other required regulatory communications.
- Conduct compliance reviews and assessments relating to potential regulatory breaches, policy violations, and control weaknesses.
- Document compliance findings, recommendations, and remediation actions and monitor progress against agreed timelines.
- Support investigations into potential compliance breaches and regulatory issues, escalating material or complex matters to the Compliance Manager.
- Support regulatory examinations, internal audits, and independent compliance reviews by preparing documentation, coordinating responses, and tracking remediation activities.
- Maintain accurate and up-to-date compliance registers, records, trackers, and supporting documentation.
- Prepare compliance reports, monitoring results, regulatory updates, risk assessments, and other materials for management review.
- Support the development and delivery of compliance training and awareness activities.
- Work closely with Risk, Legal, Internal Audit, Operations, Information Security, and business teams to strengthen compliance controls and address regulatory requirements.
- Identify opportunities to improve compliance processes, controls, monitoring activities, and reporting.
- Escalate material compliance risks, breaches, control deficiencies, and regulatory concerns to the Compliance Lead in a timely manner.
Skills, Knowledge and Expertise
- Bachelor's degree in Law, Finance, Business Administration, Accounting, Risk Management, Compliance, or a related discipline.
- At least 3 years of experience in Compliance, Regulatory Compliance, Risk Management, Governance, Audit, or a related function, preferably within banking, financial services, fintech, or another regulated environment.
- Good working knowledge of SAMA regulatory requirements and applicable Saudi financial services regulations.
- Good understanding of compliance frameworks, SAMA regulatory obligations, compliance monitoring and testing, risk assessments, and internal controls.
- Experience conducting compliance monitoring, regulatory research, compliance reviews, risk assessments, or related compliance activities.
- Experience developing, reviewing, and maintaining compliance policies, procedures, and controls.
- Ability to interpret SAMA regulatory requirements and translate them into practical business requirements and compliance actions.
- Experience supporting regulatory examinations, internal audits, compliance reviews, investigations, and remediation activities.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify regulatory risks and recommend appropriate actions.
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to work effectively with business and control functions.
- Strong attention to detail and ability to maintain accurate compliance documentation and records.
- Ability to manage multiple priorities and work independently on assigned compliance activities in a fast-paced regulated environment.
- High level of integrity, professionalism, confidentiality, and sound regulatory judgment.
- Compliance certification such as CAMS, CCO, or an equivalent certification is preferred.
- Additional certifications in risk management, governance, financial crime, or regulatory compliance are considered an advantage.
Benefits
- We have an inclusive company culture, embracing diversity, integrity and transparency. We strive for work-life balance and cherish the moments you spend with your loved ones, off-work. In the same spirit as for our product, we are caring and nurturing for our employees.
- Our people are granted 100% trust and freedom to apply their own vision and come up with their ideas from day 1 at Tabby. You are the one who takes responsibility for your area of work. We encourage everyone to think and make decisions like Tabby was their own business, well because it is. Our employee stock options programme is available for everyone.
- You will have an opportunity to learn and grow in one of the fastest growing fintech companies in the region
- We offer you relocation support as well as we guide you through all the process.
- We’ll set you up with the devices required for your work.

jobs.description:
Our client is currently hiring for the position of Lawyer- Litigation.
Responsibilities:
. Manage a portfolio of litigation and dispute resolution matters from initial assessment through resolution.
. Develop case strategies and advise clients on legal risks, potential outcomes, and appropriate courses of action.
. Prepare and review pleadings, submissions, legal opinions, correspondence, and supporting documentation.

. Coordinate with clients, courts, government authorities, experts, and other relevant parties.

. Maintain accurate case records and ensure all court and procedural deadlines are met.

jobs.title: Regional SDS Masterplan Consultant
jobs.summary: The Regional SDS Masterplan Consultant role offers a unique opportunity to contribute to combating sand and dust storms in West Asia. This consultancy, established through a collaboration between the United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) and the Saudi Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture, focuses on developing a comprehensive Regional Master Plan. The consultant will lead technical efforts, ensuring alignment and coherence in addressing environmental challenges related to sand and dust storms.
jobs.description:
Result of Service
Regional Masterplan to Combat Sand and Dust Storms for West Asia
Work Location
Home Based
Expected duration
11.5 months
Duties and Responsibilities
The United Nations Environment Programme (UNEP) is the leading global environmental authority that sets the global environmental agenda, promotes the coherent implementation of the environmental dimension of sustainable development within the United Nations system and serves as an authoritative advocate for the global environment. The regional Office for West Asia delivers advisory services and capacity building support to countries to achieve environmental and sustainable development objectives. This consultancy is established at the West Asia Office within the framework of the Strategic Cooperation Agreement between UNEP and the Ministry of Environment, Water and Agriculture (MEWA) of the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The Consultant will report to the Project Manager at the UNEP West Asia Office. Within the above context, UNEP and the National Centre for Meteorology (NCM), through its Regional Centre on Sand and Dust Stoms (SDS), will collaborate to develop the Regional Master Plan to Combat Sand and Dust Storm in West Asia. The Master Plan will capitalize on the resources and knowledge available at the Regional SDS Centre. Furthermore, The Master Plan will serve as a policy and technical document to guide actions at the regional, national and local levels to tackle the sand and dust storms across the full cycle. Considerable meteorological work has been done to monitor SDS and identify sources (hotspots). However, noticeable gaps are still apparent in identifying root causes and designing micro-scale mitigation measures and evidence-based monitoring. The Consultant will provide technical leadership for the development of the Regional SDS Masterplan, ensuring that all technical inputs are aligned, concise and consolidated into one coherent document, while also providing technical advisory support to NCM on the ongoing development of the national SDS framework, including participation in relevant meetings and review of technical inputs. 2.Duties and Responsibilities Under the direct supervision of the Project Manager in UNEP West Asia Office, and in collaboration with the Regional SDS Centre, relevant regional and national entities, the Consultant will carry out the following duties and responsibilities. 1.Conduct a Regional Literature Review on SDS Sources and Hotspots 1.1Review available studies, reports, assessments, datasets and other relevant publications addressing sand and dust storm sources, hotspots, drivers and mitigation measures in West Asia. 1.2Compile a preliminary list of SDS hotspots identified by the Regional SDS Centre and other available regional and national sources. Based on the literature review, develop practical criteria for identifying and categorizing SDS hotspots using available evidence and information. 1.3 To the extent possible, conduct a desk-based analysis of the identified SDS hotspots and prepare concise profiles for each hotspot, covering, where information is available, their location, main causes, land use and land-cover characteristics, water management and agricultural practices, topography, climatic conditions, frequency of SDS events, anthropogenic drivers, key impacts, and available evidence regarding their contribution to sand and dust storm generation. 1.4Prepare an inception report outlining the proposed methodology, literature review approach, criteria for hotspot identification and categorization, preliminary list of hotspots, workplan, and anticipated data gaps and limitations. 2.Draft of the “Regional Masterplan to Combat Sand and Dust Storms for West Asia” The Master Plan will serve as guiding document for countries, addressing SDS from multiple dimensions, especially root causes and prevention. It should contain guidelines for countries on how to develop local/national level action plans, including standardized methodologies to guide assessment, monitoring, and implementation to address sand and dust storms, especially at the hotspot level. The guidelines will also promote the integration of SDS mitigation and adaptation measures into national environmental and development policies 1.1Prepare annotated outline for the Master plan describing major sections, the information needed for each section and the rationale for it 1.2Compile data, information, and findings for the various sections of the Masterplan, while providing overall coordination and technical leadership. 1.3Coordinate closely with other experts developing specific sections of the Masterplan, including economic valuation, health impacts, and mitigation measures, to ensure coherence, coherence across sections and avoid duplication. 1.4Compile and consolidate the various sections into one comprehensive and well-structured document. 1.5Conduct stakeholder meetings with relevant institutions and NCM personnel to gather technical inputs and support the further development of the Regional Masterplan. 3.Regional Consultations The consultant will provide inputs to the national (particularly Saudi Arabia) and regional consultations, present the findings of the above tasks and gather input and feedback from the relevant stakeholders and institutions to reflect in the final Master Plan 4.Final Version of the “Regional Masterplan to Combat Sand and Dust Storms for West Asia” 4.1Refine and finalize the Masterplan, with all comments and feedback fully incorporated and addressed. 4.2Submit the final version of the Masterplan in a format ready for review, endorsement, and publication.
Qualifications/special skills
Master's degree or equivalent in Environmental Management, Land or Water Management, Climate Science, or related field is required A first-level university degree, combined with two (2) additional years of qualifying experience may be accepted in lieu of an advanced university degree. PHD degree is also desirable Minimum 10 years of experience in land and water management, or related field, is required. Proven experience in providing technical guidance and capacity-building programs is required. Experience in multistakeholder engagement and developing technical reports, is required. Strong knowledge of environmental issues in West Asia, is required. Experience in working with international organizations, government agencies, or funding institutions, is an asset.
Languages
Fluency in English and Arabic is required.
Additional Information
Not available.
No Fee
THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CHARGE A FEE AT ANY STAGE OF THE RECRUITMENT PROCESS (APPLICATION, INTERVIEW MEETING, PROCESSING, OR TRAINING). THE UNITED NATIONS DOES NOT CONCERN ITSELF WITH INFORMATION ON APPLICANTS’ BANK ACCOUNTS.

jobs.description:
Company Description
Tahaluf is the largest B2B live and on-demand events organiser in Saudi Arabia by space, attendance, colleagues, and revenue. It is a joint venture between Informa PLC, the Saudi Federation for Cybersecurity, Programming and Drones (SAFCSP), and the Events Investment Fund (EIF).
Tahaluf is bold, visionary, and determined to make an impact. Our team fosters a culture of collaboration, creativity, and a little fun, here teamwork rules and work feels as exciting as the events we create. Scaling at this pace also requires exceptional local partners, and Tahaluf is proud to work with a range of government and non-government organisations at the forefront of Saudi Arabia’s B2B and B2C large-scale events scene.
Be part of something BIG with Tahaluf’s series of record-breaking events: LEAP and Cityscape - the largest events in the world in their respective fields of tech and real estate; Black Hat MEA - a Guinness World Record holder for the largest CTF competition during the event; and CPHI Middle East - the largest pharma debut event in history, to name just a few. Tahaluf is making a huge impact on the global events sector.
Join our ambitious and highly committed team, unafraid to push boundaries and disrupt the status quo. From day one, you’ll dive into large-scale projects under the guidance of a supportive leadership team that will encourage your personal development and open doors to new opportunities.
Job Description
As the Senior Marketing Executive, you will be the strategic engine behind two of the region's most influential life science and pharmaceutical events. Your mission is to develop and execute multi-channel marketing strategies that drive high-value attendance, increase exhibitor ROI, and solidify CPHI Middle East and BIO Middle East as the "must-attend" fixtures in the regional pharma calendar.
Key Responsibilities & Deliverables
1. Strategic Planning & Execution
- Campaign Lifecycle: Lead the end-to-end marketing cycle (Awareness, Interest, Conversion, Retention) for both events.
- Segmentation: Develop a sophisticated data-segmentation strategy to target specific niches: API manufacturers, biotech startups, government regulators, and big pharma C-suite.
- Budget Management: Full ownership of the marketing budget, ensuring optimal ROI across paid, earned, and owned channels.
2. Digital & Content Marketing
- Lead Gen: Drive high-quality MQLs (Marketing Qualified Leads) for the sales team through inbound marketing and targeted LinkedIn campaigns.
- Content Authority: Oversee the creation of whitepapers, webinars, and industry reports that position the events as thought-leadership hubs.
- Automation: Manage the deployment of automated email journeys (Eloqua) to nurture prospects through the registration funnel.
3. Strategic Partnerships
- Stakeholder Relations: Act as the primary marketing liaison for local health authorities and trade associations.
- Media Management: Negotiate barter agreements and manage relationships with key regional and international trade press.
4. On-site Experience & Analysis
- Experience Design: Collaborate with the operations team to ensure the brand experience is seamless on the show floor.
- Data Reporting: Provide weekly KPI reports on registration pacing and exhibitors MQLs.
Qualifications
- Experience: 3+ years in B2B event marketing. Experience in Pharmaceutical, Biotech, or Healthcare sectors is a significant advantage.
- Marketing Tech Stack: Mastery of Marketing Automation tools
- Digital Proficiency: Hands-on experience with SEO/SEM, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, and Google Analytics (GA4).
- Language: English is essential, Arabic is a plus
- Education: Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, or a related field.
Additional Information
Please note this is a 6 month contract role. It can be performed remotely. We are not able to provide relocation or sponsorship support with the position.
We work hard to make sure life at Tahaluf is rewarding, supportive and enjoyable for everyone. We’re not solely focused on a checklist of skills. We champion energy and ambition and look for colleagues who will roll their sleeves up, join in and help make things happen. We don't just accept difference, we celebrate it. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds and circumstances and base hiring decisions on relevant qualifications and merit. We are proud to provide a disability-friendly environment. If you require any support or adjustments to participate in our interview or selection processes, please let us know.

The Role
The Social Media Manager leads our social presence through a combination of agency management and hands-on delivery. They are responsible for briefing, directing, and quality-controlling external agencies and creators who produce our social content, while owning strategy, boosting, community, and performance in-house. They will grow and engage audiences across LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube, with a strong eye for trends, creative judgement to push agencies beyond safe work, and the ability to turn content into measurable results.
Working with the Marketing Director, Head of Marketing, senior stakeholders and external vendors to support the overarching marketing strategy and commercial objectives through increased brand engagement, community growth, and social media campaigns.
Key Responsibilities
Agency and creative management
- Own the day-to-day relationship with social and creative agencies: briefing, creative direction, feedback, and final sign-off.
- Write sharp, insight-led briefs that give agencies clear objectives, audience, tone, and success measures — and push back when creative doesn't meet the standard.
- Manage agency workflows, content calendars, and deadlines across multiple events running in parallel; ensure nothing ships late or off-brand.
- Quality-control all agency output: brand voice, visual identity, accuracy, and platform fit. Act as final checkpoint before anything goes live.
- Review agency performance regularly against agreed KPIs and deliverables; manage scopes, escalate issues, and get maximum value from every retainer.
- Spot when work should move in-house versus agency, and brief internal designers and videographers when speed matters.
Strategy and campaigns
- Set and implement social media campaigns aligned with marketing strategies and event milestones: launches, registration pushes, early-bird deadlines, and show days.
- Design and deliver targeted content across platforms to increase engagement, followers, and retention — including short-form video (Reels, TikTok, Shorts) built for each platform's algorithm.
- Maintain the voice of the brand in all posts and interactions. Ensure every piece of content has a purpose and meets the needs of the target audience.
- Copywriting excellence: create and edit impactful, channel-appropriate copy with flawless proofreading in English (Arabic a strong advantage).
- Deliver live event coverage: directing agency/on-site teams to capture, edit, and publish in real time during show days.
Boosting and paid amplification
- Plan and execute boosting strategies: identify top-performing organic content and amplify with paid spend to reach targeted audiences.
- Manage boosting budgets, audience targeting, and A/B testing of creative and copy to maximise reach and conversion at the lowest cost.
- Work with the paid media team so boosted content complements broader paid campaigns rather than duplicating them.
- Retarget engaged social audiences to drive registrations and commercial outcomes, not just impressions.
Community and engagement
- Schedule, post, and engage on all social content. Respond to comments, messages, and queries in a timely manner.
- Grow and maintain the community year-round, not only during event season; ensure members feel part of the group and get real value.
- Identify and work with influencers, industry voices, and advocates; support speaker and employee advocacy to extend organic reach.
- Encourage and curate user-generated content from attendees, exhibitors, and partners.
Data and insight
- Employ a metrics-driven approach across all activity. Track and report monthly: reach, engagement, follower growth, traffic, and conversions to registration — including agency performance against KPIs.
- Use social listening to monitor brand sentiment, competitor activity, and market trends; feed insights back into briefs and plans.
- Conduct market research with a focus on customer insight and experience.
Collaboration
- Build positive relationships with internal colleagues and external stakeholders at all levels; relay the voice of the customer across the wider marketing team.
Qualifications
- 4 to 5 years experience in social media marketing, with demonstrable experience managing external agencies or creative teams.
- Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience.
- Hands-on experience with LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook, TikTok, Snapchat, and YouTube is essential.
- Proven experience running boosted and paid social campaigns, including budget management and audience targeting (Meta Ads Manager, LinkedIn Campaign Manager, or equivalent).
- Strong creative judgement: able to brief, critique, and improve agency work, not just approve it.
- Experience with scheduling and analytics tools (e.g. Sprout, Hootsuite, or native tools).

jobs.title: EV Charging Technical Lead | Al-Futtaim Automotive - BYD | KSA
jobs.summary: Take the lead in managing Al-Futtaim's EV Charging infrastructure across Saudi Arabia. As the EV Charging Technical Lead, you will ensure that all chargers are installed and maintained to the highest standards, directly impacting customer satisfaction and network uptime. Your role will bridge the gap between contractors, internal teams, and regulatory bodies, making you a pivotal player in the growth of Al-Futtaim's EV ecosystem.
jobs.description:
Overview of the Role
The EV Charging Technical Lead would be responsible for the managing Al-Futtaim's EV Charging infrastructure (Home Charging & Flash Charging) across the Kingdom of Saudi Arabia. The role operates at the intersection of hands-on site execution, contractor governance, and structured technical reporting, ensuring every charger deployed under the Charge2Moov network is installed, commissioned, and maintained to OEM and regulatory standards.
Reporting to the Senior Manager – EV Charging, the position acts as the single point of technical accountability between field contractors, internal commercial and aftersales stakeholders, and KSA regulatory bodies including SE, SASO, and MOMRAH. The Technical Lead directly influences network uptime, customer satisfaction, and the scale-out roadmap of Al-Futtaim's EV charging ecosystem — a strategic pillar of the brand's KSA EV proposition.
What You Will Do
Field Operations & Technical Support
- Attend, investigate, and resolve customer complaints on AC home chargers and DC public chargers across all assigned sites within the Kingdom.
- Perform on-site diagnostics, fault rectification, and corrective maintenance to restore charger uptime within agreed SLA windows.
- Execute software upgrades, firmware patches, and configuration management activities on AC charger hardware.
- Carry out Level-1 maintenance and structured fault diagnosis on DC fast-chargers in line with OEM guidelines.
- Support commissioning and functional testing of newly installed chargers, issuing technical sign-off only after full verification against acceptance criteria.
- Conduct detailed site surveys and technical readiness assessments prior to DC charger installation.
Installation Oversight & Compliance
- Coordinate with SE-certified contractors to plan, schedule, and supervise AC and DC charger installations across showroom, retail, and customer sites.
- Monitor installation activities to ensure adherence to technical specifications, electrical safety standards (SASO / SE), and applicable MOMRAH regulations.
- Review contractor workmanship, raise non-conformance items, and track closure through to final acceptance.
- Manage the technical interfaces between civil, electrical, and networking trades on multi-discipline installation projects.
- Ensure zero safety or regulatory non-compliance incidents across all supervised installation activity.
Reporting & Documentation
- Prepare and submit structured technical reports to the Senior Manager – EV Charging covering installation progress, commissioning status, and field findings.
- Produce site survey reports, commercial quotation, and technical snag lists for every site visit.
- Maintain accurate maintenance logs, fault registers, and resolution records for every charger asset under management.
- Compile weekly and monthly dashboards tracking charger uptime, open faults, contractor performance, and installation milestones.
- Document escalation cases with clear root-cause analysis and corrective and preventive action recommendations.
- Ensure all field records are retained in the designated document management system in a timely and accurate manner.
Stakeholder & Contractor Coordination
- Act as the primary technical liaison between internal teams (Business Development, Aftersales, Commercial) and external contractors or vendors.
- Facilitate timely resolution of technical issues by escalating appropriately and tracking follow-up actions to closure.
- Support procurement with technical input on bill of materials, scopes of work, and contractor pre-qualification and evaluation.
- Represent EV Charging Engineering in project site meetings, client walkthroughs, and regulatory inspections.
Skills
Required Skills to Be Successful
- Strong technical diagnostic capability on both AC and DC EV charging hardware.
- Solid grounding in LV/MV electrical safety practices and site installation methodology.
- Analytical problem-solving mindset with a structured approach to root-cause analysis.
- Clear written and verbal communication for technical reporting and stakeholder updates.
- Effective contractor and vendor coordination with the ability to hold third parties to quality standards.
- Self-driven field execution capability — able to operate independently across multiple KSA sites.
- Structured reporting discipline and comfort building weekly / monthly performance dashboards.
- Resilience under pressure, flexibility on working hours, and willingness to travel extensively across the Kingdom.
What Qualifies You for the Role
- Bachelor's Degree or Diploma in Electrical Engineering, Electronics, Power Systems, or a closely related technical discipline.
- 3–6 years of progressive field experience in EV charging systems, electrical infrastructure, or power distribution.
- Demonstrated hands-on experience with AC (Type 2 ) and DC fast-charger hardware from OEMs such as Siemens, Wallbox, ABB, or equivalent.
- Proven contractor supervision experience across multi-site installation programs.
- Working knowledge of Saudi Energy utility interface requirements, SASO product standards, and MOMRAH EV mandates.
- Familiarity with basic networking for connected charger infrastructure.
- Professional certification in EV charging systems, power electronics, or electrical safety is a strong advantage.
- Valid KSA driving licence and willingness to work field-based across the Kingdom.
- Business-level English essential; professional Arabic proficiency is an advantage for contractor and regulatory engagement

jobs.description:
CRM Program Manager (contract - remote)
Team: Consumer Marketing
Reports to: Head of Consumer Marketing
Level: Manager (program-level ownership)
About Cambly
Cambly is a global language learning platform that connects learners with tutors for real conversation practice, supported by AI-powered learning tools. We help students around the world build confidence and fluency in English.
About the Role
We're looking for a CRM Program Manager to lead Cambly's customer relationship management strategy and execution — delivering the right message to the right customer at the right time, via the right channel. This is a global role covering Cambly's markets across Latin America, Europe/Middle East, and Asia. You will run one CRM strategy with market-specific channel and messaging execution. You'll own CRM across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, including expansion into local chat platforms such as WhatsApp, WeChat, and KakaoTalk.
This role combines strategic program management, cross-functional leadership, and CRM platform expertise to drive acquisition, engagement, and retention based on deep analysis of user behavior. You'll own the CRM roadmap, platform strategy, audience strategy, deliverability health, major CRM initiatives (including AI integrations), and performance measurement across regions. You'll partner with creative, growth, product, data, engineering, and regional teams, and work closely with operational specialists who execute day-to-day campaign setup.
What You'll DoCRM Strategy & Program Leadership
-
Own the end-to-end CRM strategy across email, in-app, push, and messaging apps, aligned to acquisition, engagement, and retention KPIs.
-
Build and maintain the CRM roadmap, balancing evergreen lifecycle programs, promotional campaigns, and strategic initiatives.
-
Own the messaging-app channel strategy by market: WhatsApp (e.g., Brazil, Turkey, Arabic-speaking markets), WeChat (China), KakaoTalk (Korea), and other local platforms as markets warrant. Lead each from evaluation and pilot through rollout.
-
Set the global CRM framework and define what can be localized by market (channel mix, timing, offers, tone) and what stays standard.
-
Serve as the single point of accountability for CRM outcomes and leadership reporting.
CRM Platform & Vendor Management
-
Evaluate and manage messaging providers and official business account setups per platform (e.g., WhatsApp Business API providers, WeChat Official Accounts, KakaoTalk business channels), including template approvals and platform policy compliance.
-
Own platform relationships (e.g., Iterable), including contracts, roadmap alignment, feature adoption, and renewals.
-
Drive strategic CRM innovation projects, such as AI/LLM integrations with the CRM stack, from discovery through rollout and measurement.
-
Identify gaps across the CRM stack and champion investments that reduce cost, improve efficiency, or unlock new capabilities.
Audiences & Lifecycle Journeys
-
Partner with PMs and engineers to co-design lifecycle programs, in-product messaging surfaces, event instrumentation, and journey delivery mechanics.
-
Define audience segmentation and lead qualification frameworks — who we reach, via which channel, and at which lifecycle stage.
-
Own audiences and lists across markets: segmentation, hygiene, suppression, and ongoing maintenance.
-
Develop customer journey and audience insights that improve profitability, delivery, and engagement.
-
Design and oversee automated journeys, personalization, and experimentation standards (subject lines, send times, cohorts, journey structures), including promotional updates.
Analytics, Measurement & Optimization
-
Own CRM KPIs, dashboards, and reporting across all channels.
-
Report CRM performance by market and channel, with cross-market comparisons in the WBR.
-
Own email deliverability health (bounces, spam complaints, warming, IP/domain reputation), partnering with engineering and ESPs.
-
Design and lead CRM experiments and turn learnings into durable program improvements.
-
Tie CRM performance to business outcomes (LTV, retention, activation, payback) with actionable recommendations.
Cross-Functional Program Management
-
Lead planning, execution, and retros for major campaigns (promotions, product launches, regional initiatives).
-
Partner with product and data teams to make every initiative measurable end-to-end — event tracking, data pipelines, attribution, and metric integrity.
-
Coordinate workstreams across marketing, product, engineering, data, and regional stakeholders.
-
Document CRM processes, playbooks, and standards so execution is repeatable.
-
Secure creative resourcing before committing to timelines; write clear creative briefs, and step in on messaging and copy when needed.
AI, Automation & Innovation
-
Automate reporting, monitoring, and manual workflows using AI, scripts, and no-code/low-code tools.
-
Use AI to deliver high-quality, culturally accurate localization and scale content without sacrificing brand voice.
-
Lead AI adoption within CRM — personalization, copy generation, segmentation, and journey optimization — and share learnings across marketing.
What We're Looking For
-
5+ years of experience in CRM, lifecycle, or retention marketing, ideally at a consumer subscription, mobile, or edtech company.
-
Hands-on expertise with a modern CRM/ESP platform (e.g., Iterable, Braze, Customer.io), including journey building and segmentation.
-
Proven track record owning CRM strategy and roadmap with measurable impact on acquisition, engagement, and retention.
-
Strong analytical skills — comfortable with dashboards, experimentation, and SQL or similar tools.
-
Working knowledge of email deliverability best practices.
-
Experience running multi-market or international CRM programs; familiarity with messaging apps like WhatsApp, WeChat, or KakaoTalk is a plus.
-
Excellent cross-functional program management and stakeholder communication skills.
-
Strong writing skills and the ability to brief creative teams or draft copy directly.
-
Curiosity and hands-on experience using AI and automation to improve marketing workflows.
What Success Looks Like
-
CRM is a clearly defined, strategically led function with a published roadmap and measurable impact.
-
Audiences are well segmented and maintained; deliverability is strong and proactively managed.
-
CRM is meaningfully expanded onto local chat platforms, driving incremental engagement and revenue.
-
Journey and audience insights drive higher-profitability segments and better engagement — not just more sends.
-
CRM results are clearly and consistently represented in the Weekly Business Review.
-
Product, data, and engineering see CRM as a true technical partner — every initiative is instrumented from day one.
-
The CRM stack is used to its full potential, and major initiatives are delivered end-to-end.
-
Manual workflows are increasingly automated, and AI powers high-quality localization and content at scale.

Project Control Manager LOCATION
Riyadh, Saudi Arabia
project description
The project is a major infrastructure programme for a mixed-use development aiming to be a global landmark recognized for its unique vision and position as an authentic destination in Riyadh. The community will be a distinct, self-sustaining hub for Riyadh offering several iconic assets. KBR will provide PMO services, enterprise – level governance, assurance, integration and performance oversight across all projects and programs.
THE ROLE
Reporting to the Project Controls Director, the Project Controls Manager is responsible to maintain, govern, implement and provide pre and post contract implementation governance for the suite of Project Controls policies, management plans, standards, procedures, and processes, in support of reporting requirements and systems, i.e. Aconex, Unifier, P6 etc. The Project Control Manager is required to perform regular review and update of the existing governance documents on quarterly / annual basis.
MAIN RESPONSIBILITIES
· Onboarding and training of the PMCs to facilitate the understanding of the Programme, policies, processes and associated project management information systems and applications.
· Maintain, implement, and administer the PMC onboarding process and welcome pack documents and continuously update the PMC onboarding tracker.
· Maintain and implement the Project Controls governance structure, including roles and responsibilities (RACI) across all levels downstream.
· Review the existing structure, propose improvements, and align with on required updates/changes.
· Maintain, review and update all Reporting Governance Documents, including management plans., manuals, guidelines, templates, etc.
· Develop, implement, and administer a comprehensive programme meeting and reporting Calendar for assigned District/Master Plan.
· Manage and maintain the PMIS-driven business intelligence (BI) reporting platform, including preparation and creation of the new required BI dashboards and data entry registers through the approved systems, i.e. SharePoint, Unifier, etc.
· Compile data from PMCs for standardised weekly, monthly, and executive-level dashboards.
· Perform project level performance reporting for schedule, cost, risk, procurement, OHSE, change management.
· Responsible for ensuring consistent data definitions, KPIs, and red-amber-green (RAG) criteria across all reports.
· Assist with the preparation of training material to provide the required training to PMCs on the use of the implemented systems and population of data/registers.
· Provide support to the client for Project Controls Team for related PMIS and Data Warehouse (DWH) requirements.
· Responsible to maintain, implement, and administer a process for tracking and monitoring the PMC's performance against agreed KPI's, and produce a monthly report highlighting each PMC performance with the any required corrective actions.
· Update the status of corrective actions during the subsequent reporting cycles.
· Assess existing monitoring system and propose enhancements and improvements to the overall process.
· Ensure that PMC’s reporting schedules are consistent with the PMO preparation of executive reports.
· Review and collate the District/Master Plan programmes to produce and maintain the Integrated Master Schedule (IMS).
· Establish and implement Project Controls Compliance Audit Requirements and conduct regular PMC audits to ensure adherence to standards and policies.
· Implement processes and systems to monitor the timely completion of Stage Gate Reviews and the reporting across assigned District/Master Plan highlighting issues and/or risks that may impact the delivery of the programme.
· Maintain issue the “KPI's Report” on monthly basis with highlight of key areas of concern with corrective measures and mitigation.
· Produce a “Key Actions Required” report and escalation process to ensure all required actions are presented to executive management for escalation and action plans.
· Prepare the monthly Programme Status Report that highlights the overall programme, district and individual project’s status and progress including each project’s status against the approved dates, schedule alerts, and key issues hindering project progress.
· Managing and updating the existing Work Breakdown Structure (WBS) with updates recorded within the WBS change register.
· Maintain an updated mapping tracker between WBS, CBS, and SAP projects.
· Prepare monthly Programme Level Status Report that highlights the overall programme level, District levels, and individual project’s level status and progress.
· Prepare required inputs for preparation of Executive Reports including programme and commercial update information and programme “asks” requirements from collate information from the client.
· Develop and implement a Value Engineering Management plan, process, and templates with communication and training provided to PMCs to record savings against the Budget (Total Development Cost)
· Develop and maintain a standardised Cost Breakdown Structure (CBS) across all programmes and projects to ensure consistent cost planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting with alignment between CBS, WBS, work packages, procurement strategies, and budgeting requirements.
· Develop maintain a structured Work Package Identification framework to ensure that all projects scope is clearly defined, consistently structured, and effectively aligned with planning, cost, procurement, and delivery.
EXPERIENCE, SKILLS AND KNOWLEDGE
· Bachelor’s degree or equivalent in engineering, architecture, construction management, planning, management information systems or equivalent.· Minimum 12 years of post-graduation experience
· PMI-Project Management Professional, AACE- Certified Cost Professional (CCP) or Planning and Scheduling Professional (PSP), MRICS, CIOB, or equivalent prior experience.
· Sound knowledge of controls and reporting aspects of major civil, infrastructure and development projects including urban developments, high-rise buildings, roads, bridges, and utilities.
· Experienced user of MS Office and understanding of project reporting software including Oracle Unifier, P6, Aconex, etc.
· Fluency in English language both written and spoken.
COMPETENCIES
· Leadership
· Strong interpersonal and communication skills
· Commercial and planning awareness
· Strong customer focus
· Planning & organising
· Accepts Responsibility
· HSE Awareness

jobs.title: Sr. Project Control Manager
jobs.summary: Elevate your career as a Senior Project Control Manager in Saudi Arabia, where your expertise will shape the future of construction. At El Seif, we are committed to excellence, integrity, and innovation, ensuring every project is delivered with precision. With decades of diverse experience, you will lead strategic project controls on high-value mega-projects, driving exceptional results and pioneering sustainable solutions.
jobs.description:
Building the Future - One Project at a Time!
At El Seif, we embrace and embody our core values of excellence, integrity, and innovation in every aspect of our work from meticulous planning to expert construction, we consistently uphold the highest standards of excellence, ensuring that our projects are delivered with precision and attention to detail. With half a century of diverse experiences across a wide range of industries, ranging from public infrastructure to military and defense applications, we have honed our expertise and gained indispensable insights that enable us to tackle complex challenges and maintain our standard of delivering exceptional results. Our forward-thinking approach sets us apart as a trusted partner in the construction industry. By continuously pushing the boundaries of innovation, we strive to pioneer the future of construction, creating sustainable and impactful solutions that leave a lasting legacy.
Excellence, Integrity and, Innovation - every step of the way.
Responsibilities:
Working as a strategic partner to the Project Director on very-high-value mega-projects, the Senior Project Controls Manager (SPCM) provides expert leadership and strategic management of the integrated Project Controls function. This role is accountable for the integrity and defense of the Performance Measurement Baseline (PMB) across multiple complex work packages, ensuring project control systems serve as predictive instruments for successful delivery. The SPCM leads the strategy for complex Extension of Time (EoT) claims, provides expert internal and external stakeholder diplomacy, and drives the continuous improvement of project-level control standards and risk governance to safeguard the company’s financial and contractual position.
- Establish, lead, and provide strategic direction to a large Project Controls team of Planning, Cost Control, and Risk professionals. Ensure the function operates as a proactive advisor to senior project leadership, providing high-impact insights to drive mega-project outcomes.
- Establish and enforce the Project Controls Plan (PCP) as the strategic governing framework for the project. Ensure all activities, including those of diverse subcontractors, comply with the highest contractual standards and corporate SOPs while championing the use of advanced digital tools
- Direct the establishment and maintenance of a resource-loaded PMB for the mega-project, ensuring all schedule, cost, and resource data are integrated across multiple complex work packages to provide a single source of truth
- Direct the development and governance of the mega-project’s complex scheduling hierarchy, ensuring the long-term critical path is resilient and logically robust. Lead the integration of 30/60/90-day look-ahead schedules across multiple disciplines and subcontractors, ensuring site productivity data validates remaining durations. Oversee expert analysis of float variance to provide early warnings of potential delays and proactively support Change Management and claim assessment processes.
- Lead the project’s strategy for complex Extension of Time (EoT) and prolongation claims. Oversee advanced Time Impact Analysis (TIA) and CPM modeling to maximize compensable outcomes and mitigate concurrent delay risks

jobs.title: Quality Engineer - Water Leak
jobs.summary: As a Water Leak Engineer at Lucid, you'll lead critical investigations to diagnose and resolve water leak issues, ensuring the highest quality standards in our innovative vehicles. This role demands collaboration with cross-functional teams to protect production lines from water ingress, driving excellence in vehicle performance and customer satisfaction. Your expertise will be pivotal in shaping the future of mobility through effective problem-solving and proactive quality assurance.
jobs.description:
About Lucid
At Lucid, we are creating exceptional mobility experiences through innovation to drive the world forward. Built on Lucid’s proprietary technology and software-defined vehicle architecture, our award-winning vehicles bring our “Compromise Nothing™” approach to the global automotive market. That means refusing to choose between performance and sustainability, design and engineering, ambition and integrity. In Lucid Air and Lucid Gravity, we have designed and built vehicles that have redefined their segments, combining exceptional range, performance, design, and expansive space in a single experience. 
We achieve this through deep vertical integration, with design, engineering, and production happening in-house across our global offices and manufacturing facilities. Our teams come from industries around the world, united by a shared commitment to excellence. By refusing to settle, you can help redefine what’s possible and shape the future of mobility.
The Water Leak Engineer is responsible for water leak diagnosis, leak path identification, root cause analysis, and issue reproduction at AMP2 KSA. Working in a challenging and fast-paced environment, the engineer leads Water Leak Technicians and collaborates with cross-functional teams throughout the entire product lifecycle.
 The role focuses on proactively protecting Lucid production lines from water ingress and sealing-related quality issues through effective investigation, testing, containment, and corrective actions.
The Water Leak Engineer works closely with Quality Engineering, Manufacturing Quality, Design Engineering, and Repair Teams to ensure vehicle quality, durability, and customer satisfaction.
Key Responsibilities:
- Lead Water Leak investigation and resolution activities at Lucid AMP2 KSA.
- Ensure safety requirements and Personal Protective Equipment (PPE) are followed in
the work area.
- Maintain a safe and clean work environment in accordance with 6S standards.
- Execute water leak testing protocols and conduct leak diagnosis, troubleshooting, and root cause analysis to identify leak paths and confirm causes.
- Support Manufacturing Quality in resolving water leak issues identified during Pre-
Delivery Inspection and Lucid Customer Product Audits (LCPA).
- Perform water leak tests using approved methods and equipment, including rain
booths, water spray systems, and validation tools.
- Support water leak root cause investigations for field and customer-reported issues.
- Lead root cause analysis and validation of corrective actions and countermeasures for
water leak concerns.
- Document water leak test procedures, findings, and investigation results.
- Maintain water leak testing equipment, tools, and inspection devices in good working
condition.
- Collaborate with cross-functional teams to improve vehicle sealing performance and
water leak prevention.
- Ensure strict compliance with Lucid Motors Quality Procedures and standards.
- Conduct water leak assessments on vehicles and sub-systems as required during launch
and mass production phases.
- Provide feedback and support manufacturing process improvements related to water
leak prevention and sealing quality.
- Support repair development and validation for water leak issues from launch through
mass production.
- Train quality and production team members on water leak inspection methods, testing
procedures, and acceptance criteria.
- Lead water leak validation activities using environmental chambers, rain test facilities,
and vehicle validation tests as required.
Skills :
- Ability to read and interpret electrical schematics, vehicle drawings, and body sealing
specifications.
- Hands-on experience in water leak testing, leak detection methods, and troubleshooting
techniques.
- Knowledge of water leak testing methodologies, including rain booth testing, water
spray testing, flood testing, and environmental chamber validation.
- Familiarity with vehicle sealing systems, body closures, glazing, weatherstrips, body
joints, and water management paths.
- Good verbal and written communication skills.
- Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause investigation abilities.
- Cross-functional team player with the ability to work effectively with Quality,
Manufacturing, Design, and Repair teams.
- Creative, energetic, self-motivated, and highly organized.
- Experience using diagnostic tools and documentation systems for defect tracking and
corrective action management.
- Ability to validate corrective actions and support continuous improvement initiatives
related to water leak prevention and vehicle sealing performance.
Minimum Qualifications:
- BSc/master’s degree in mechanical engineering discipline is required.
- 2-5 years of experience within a greenfield OEM is a must.
- Minimum 3 years of experience in the same role is a Must.
- Good verbal, written, and presentation skills.
- Able to motivate, influence, gain consensus and can interface well with senior
management.
- Ability to work in a fast-paced environment with multiple simultaneous projects.
- Strong data analysis and visualization skills.
- Ability to lead complex issues and communicate with different levels of the
organization.
- Familiarity with Manufacturing Execution System applications is a plus.
