jobs.title: QAQC Engineer
jobs.summary: As a QAQC Engineer at AECOM, you will play a crucial role in ensuring that all installed commodities meet established specifications and design requirements. Your expertise in quality assurance and quality control will be essential in conducting inspections, material testing, and maintaining comprehensive quality records. With a commitment to delivering a better world, AECOM offers an opportunity to make a tangible impact in infrastructure projects globally.
jobs.description:
Company Description
Work with Us. Change the World.
At AECOM, we're delivering a better world. Whether improving your commute, keeping the lights on, providing access to clean water, or transforming skylines, our work helps people and communities thrive. We are the world's trusted infrastructure consulting firm, partnering with clients to solve the world’s most complex challenges and build legacies for future generations.
There has never been a better time to be at AECOM. With accelerating infrastructure investment worldwide, our services are in great demand. We invite you to bring your bold ideas and big dreams and become part of a global team of over 50,000 planners, designers, engineers, scientists, digital innovators, program and construction managers and other professionals delivering projects that create a positive and tangible impact around the world.
We're one global team driven by our common purpose to deliver a better world. Join us.
Job Description
Position Overview:
Under general supervision, the QAQC Engineer performs quality assurance and quality control duties to ensure all installed commodities meet established specifications and design requirements.
Key Responsibilities:
Inspection & Evaluation:
- Independently perform walk-downs and inspections of installed commodities to assure conformance with specifications and design requirements
- Evaluate, select, and apply standard engineering techniques, procedures, and criteria to meet basic engineering and construction specifications
- Conduct material testing and verification to confirm compliance with project specifications and industry standards
- Display sound professional judgment on details of work and construction quality
Documentation & Reporting:
- Perform quantity surveys for tracking and reporting purposes
- Document non-conformances and prepare corrective action reports with recommendations for remediation
- Maintain comprehensive quality records, inspection logs, and test documentation for project archival and regulatory compliance
- Generate quality metrics reports and analyze trends to identify areas for continuous improvement
Technical Leadership & Coordination:
- Provide technical direction to drafters, technicians, and surveyors as needed
- Coordinate with project teams, contractors, and stakeholders to communicate quality requirements and inspection findings
- Ensure adherence to applicable codes, standards, and regulatory requirements throughout the project lifecycle
- Support site safety initiatives and quality assurance protocols to maintain a compliant work environment
Qualifications
Required Qualifications:
- Minimum 10 years of progressive experience in site supervision, quality assurance, and quality control on construction projects
- Bachelor's degree in Civil Engineering, Construction Management, or related engineering discipline
- Demonstrated expertise in conducting inspections, material testing, and verification of construction commodities against specifications
- Proficiency in technical documentation, report writing, and maintaining comprehensive quality records and inspection logs
- Strong knowledge of applicable construction codes, industry standards, and regulatory compliance requirements
- Excellent communication and coordination skills with ability to provide technical direction to team members and stakeholders
- Sound professional judgment and analytical skills for identifying non-conformances and recommending corrective actions
Preferred Qualifications:
- Professional Engineer (PE) license or Engineer-in-Training (EIT) certification
- QAQC or quality management certifications (ASQ, ISO 9001, or equivalent)
- Experience with quality management systems and continuous improvement methodologies
- Proficiency in construction management software and data analysis tools
- Background in site safety protocols and OSHA compliance
Additional Information
At AECOM, we are committed to maintaining a secure and trustworthy recruitment process and take any fraudulent hiring activity seriously. To support this commitment, all newly hired employees are required to attend an in-person Day 1 onboarding at an AECOM office location as a condition of employment.
About AECOM
AECOM is proud to offer comprehensive benefits to meet the diverse needs of our employees. Depending on your employment status, AECOM benefits may include medical, dental, vision, life, AD&D, disability benefits, paid time off, leaves of absences, voluntary benefits, perks, flexible work options, well-being resources, employee assistance program, business travel insurance, service recognition awards, retirement savings plan, and employee stock purchase plan.
AECOM is the global infrastructure leader, committed to delivering a better world. As a trusted professional services firm powered by deep technical abilities, we solve our clients’ complex challenges in water, environment, energy, transportation and buildings. Our teams partner with public- and private-sector clients to create innovative, sustainable and resilient solutions throughout the project lifecycle – from advisory, planning, design and engineering to program and construction management. AECOM is a Fortune 500 firm that had revenue of $16.1 billion in fiscal year 2025. Learn more at aecom.com.
What makes AECOM a great place to work
You will be part of a global team that champions your growth and career ambitions. Work on groundbreaking projects - both in your local community and on a global scale - that are transforming our industry and shaping the future. With cutting-edge technology and a network of experts, you’ll have the resources to make a real impact. Our award-winning training and development programs are designed to expand your technical expertise and leadership skills, helping you build the career you’ve always envisioned. Here, you’ll find a welcoming workplace built on respect, collaboration and community - where you have the freedom to grow in a world of opportunity.

You will conduct vital quality inspections, ensuring compliance with design specifications and safety standards. This role is essential in maintaining the integrity of our aircraft structures and mechanical systems, contributing to the excellence of our production process.

Job Description:
Airbus Americas, Inc is looking for a Quality Inspector to join our team based in Mobile, AL.
You will be responsible for the execution and confirmation of quality inspections as part of the production process with an emphasis on the aircraft structure and mechanical systems.
Meet the Team:
Our Engineers at the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing facility take our aircraft from concept to customer delivery – working with production teams on every aspect of assembly from managing technical information, quality control, maintenance tasks and health & safety – along flowlines and flightlines. Join our team and watch our aircraft come to life.
Your Working Environment:
On ‘Airbus Way’ you will find the Airbus U.S. Manufacturing Facility for commercial aircraft. Opened at the Mobile Aeroplex at Brookley in 2015, the facility produces A320 Family aircraft and added a second product line for the A220 in 2019. The facility, which strengthens the U.S. aerospace industry, is part of Airbus’ strategy to enhance its global competitiveness by meeting the growing needs of its customers in the United States and beyond.
How We Care for You:
- Financial Rewards: Competitive base salary, incentive compensation which may include profit sharing schemes, retirement savings plan and the ability to participate in an Employee Stock Ownership Plan (“ESOP”)
- Work/Life Balance: Paid time off including personal time, holidays and a generous paid parental leave program.
- Health & Welfare: Comprehensive insurance coverage including medical (traditional and high-deductible health plans), prescription, dental, vision, life, disability, Employee Assistance Plan (“EAP”) and other supplemental benefit coverages.
- Individual Development: Upskilling and development opportunities through our global Leadership University, including unlimited access to 10,000+ e-learning courses focusing on ways to develop your employability, certifications, career path as well as the opportunity to participate in accelerated development programmes and both national and international mobility.

- Execute technical inspections in the production process of the aircraft in the context of the authorization of manufacturer operation
- Prepare and perform visual, incoming, first article, final inspections during aircraft manufacture for compliance with design specifications, customers and certification requirements.
- Document the technical inspections performed in the multiple production orders SAP-based and the relevant SAL-based IT systems by inspection marks and complete other aircraft documents as well as prepare first article inspection reports.
- Support troubleshooting, Functional Test Procedures(FTPs) and participate in Quality Survey requests.
- Compile all technical data of non-conformance in order to launch the NCMS-based quality discrepancy sheets for the professional assessment in accordance with the manufacturing engineering documentation.
- Document all the results of the technical inspector in the FLEXNET/NCMS/SAP based IT system.
- Attain skills to perform audits of Non-Conformance Rework Orders as part of the Material

- Perform audits/reviews of workbooks to validate PV approval and process adherence.
- Track and maintain components during the Non Conformance process.
- Perform other duties as assigned

- 3 years of experience as a Quality Inspector in an aviation company with an emphasis on mechanical and/or structural components and assemblies.
- Previous experience in a mechanic or technician role is highly desirable
- Airline experience is desirable
- Knowledge of Quality Management Systems.
- Knowledge of drawing systems, inspection plans, and inspection coordination.
- Knowledge of the principles, practices, methods and tools used in the production line.
- Handling and use of inspection tools of the length measuring techniques (mechanical, optical, electrical)
- Effective verbal and written communication skills. Specifically, in English which is required operating in a multicultural and multifunctional environment.
Licensure/Certifications:
- A&P License (preferred)
Travel Required:
- Some travel required

- Lifting: able to lift documents, tools, drawings, electronic equipment up to 30lbs/14kgs.

jobs.title: Mechanical Inspector
jobs.summary: An experienced QC Mechanical / Vendor Inspector (QM-07 Approved) is sought for independent vendor surveillance and shop inspections. The role involves testing static mechanical commodities, focusing on valves, pressure vessels, and piping components, while adhering to Saudi Aramco standards and international engineering codes.
jobs.description:
We are seeking an experienced QC Mechanical / Vendor Inspector (QM-07 Approved) to join our Third-Party Inspection team. In this role, you will be responsible for conducting independent vendor surveillance, shop inspections, and testing of static mechanical commodities—with a major focus on valves, pressure vessels, and piping components—strictly following Saudi Aramco standards (SAMSS), SA-175 forms, and applicable international engineering codes.
Key Responsibilities:
- Represent the organization as a Third-Party Inspector (TPI) at vendor manufacturing and fabrication facilities across the region.
- Perform shop inspections and witness quality hold points for valves (QM-07) and mechanical commodities, including material verification, dimensional checks, wall thickness, and flange facing inspections.
- Witness hydrostatic, pneumatic (shell, seat, backseat), and operational cycle tests in accordance with API 598, API 6D, ASME B16.34, and relevant Aramco 04-SAMSS specifications.
- Review Mill Test Certificates (MTC / EN 10204 3.1/3.2), verify Positive Material Identification (PMI) results, and ensure heat number traceability.
- Review and approve welding documentation (WPS, PQR, WQR) and witness/evaluate NDT activities (VT, PT, MT, RTFI, UT).
- Attend Pre-Inspection Meetings (PIM) with clients, EPC contractors, and manufacturers to finalize and align on the Inspection and Test Plan (ITP).
- Issue Non-Conformance Reports (NCR) and Deficiency Notices (DN) when deviations occur, tracking corrective actions through to verified resolution.
- Review Manufacturer Data Reports (MDR) and inspection dossiers prior to stamping and issuing the Inspection Release Certificate (IRC).
Skills
- Aramco Approvals: Valid Saudi Aramco Approval / CBT Passed for QM-07 (Valves); additional QMs (QM-03, QM-05, QM-11,QM-12,QM-30, QM-35, QM-36, QM-37) are highly preferred.
- Education: Bachelor’s Degree in Mechanical Engineering (5+ years TPI/QC experience) or Diploma in Mechanical Engineering (5-6 years experience).
- Certifications:
- CSWIP 3.1 / 3.2 or AWS CWI Certified Welding Inspector.
- ASNT Level II in VT, PT, MT, and RTFI (UT is an advantage).
- API Certifications (API 510, API 570, API 598/6D awareness, API SIFE) are strongly advantageous.
- Codes & Standards: In-depth knowledge of Saudi Aramco Engineering Standards (SAES/SAMSS/SA-175), API 6D, API 598, ASME B16.34, ASME Section VIII, and ASME B31.3.
- Core Competencies: Vendor Inspection Division (VID) procedures, PIM coordination, material testing (PMI/Hardness), pressure test witnessing, NCR resolution, and IRC release documentation.
- Language & Communication: Strong professional English reporting and technical communication skills.

jobs.title: Instrumentation and Controls Manager / Senior MEP Project Manager
jobs.summary: This role is pivotal for delivering a major entertainment and luxury hospitality project in Saudi Arabia, requiring a seasoned Instrumentation and Controls Manager or Senior MEP Project Manager. The successful candidate will lead the integration and commissioning of complex building services and control systems, ensuring seamless operation across multiple assets. A strong technical background in plant control systems and proven project management experience in large-scale developments is essential.
jobs.description:
Instrumentation and Controls Manager / Senior MEP Project Manager
The project:
This project offers the chance to join a talented Mace team in delivering a major entertainment and luxury hospitality project, collaborating with renowned architects and global consultants. The project involves extensive infrastructure and built assets, delivered rapidly through a hands-on construction management approach, ideal for those experienced in managing both main and sub-contract packages.
The Role:
Mace is seeking an experienced Instrumentation & Controls Manager / Senior MEP Project Manager to lead the delivery, integration and commissioning of complex building services, technology and control systems across major infrastructure and development programmes.
Working as part of the PMC team, you will be responsible for overseeing the design, coordination, installation, testing and integration of specialist MEP, ICT and control systems, ensuring seamless operation across multiple assets and stakeholders. The role requires a strong technical background in plant control systems, smart building technologies and systems integration, combined with proven project management capabilities within large-scale, multidisciplinary developments.
Your Responsibilities:
·Leading the delivery of instrumentation, controls, automation and specialist MEP systems from design through commissioning and handover.
·Managing all project phases including design reviews, procurement support, construction oversight, testing, commissioning and operational readiness.
·Acting as the primary technical authority for PMS, SCADA, BMS, CCMS, EMS, ELV and integrated building technology systems.
·Coordinating multidisciplinary teams including consultants, contractors, vendors, specialist integrators and client stakeholders.
·Reviewing and validating system architecture, control philosophies, network topologies and integration strategies.
·Driving Systems Integration (MSI) activities to ensure seamless communication between mechanical, electrical, ICT, ELV and operational technology platforms.
·Monitoring project progress, managing technical risks and implementing mitigation strategies to ensure successful delivery.
·Reviewing contractor submissions, shop drawings, method statements, testing procedures and commissioning plans.
·Managing factory acceptance testing (FAT), site acceptance testing (SAT), integrated systems testing and performance validation.
·Leading stakeholder workshops and technical coordination meetings while providing regular reporting on programme, risks and delivery status.
·Ensuring compliance with project specifications, international standards, local regulations and industry best practice.
·Supporting operational handover, training, asset information management and lifecycle readiness.
You'll Need To Have:
·Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Instrumentation Engineering, Controls Engineering, Mechatronics or a related discipline.
·Approximately 15+ years of experience delivering complex MEP, infrastructure or large development projects.
·Proven experience managing instrumentation, controls and automation systems within major programmes.
·Strong technical knowledge of PMS, SCADA, BMS, CCMS, EMS, PLC, DDC and integrated control systems.
·Experience leading Master Systems Integration (MSI) activities and coordinating interfaces between multiple technology platforms.
·Demonstrable experience with complex infrastructure, utilities, district cooling, transportation, aviation, data centre, healthcare, mixed-use or large-scale development projects.
·Strong understanding of testing, commissioning, integrated systems testing and operational handover processes.
·Experience reviewing technical designs, specifications, control strategies and contractor deliverables.
·Excellent stakeholder management, communication and reporting skills.
Experience managing consultants, contractors and specialist vendors within a PMC, consultancy or client-side environment.
·GCC or Middle East project experience preferred.
·Strong understanding of Interface management'
·Proven track record of stakeholder management'
Our values
Safety first - Going home safe and well: We champion a safe, diverse, and inclusive working environment, understanding the importance of well-being in every team.
Client focus - Deliver on our promise: We own the quality of deliverables and strategic outcomes and build long-term relationships with our clients.
Integrity - Always do the right thing: We influence positive outcomes within our industry while always aligning with our compliance obligations.
Create opportunity - For our people to excel: We champion a continuous improvement culture throughout all activities, inspiring our people and teams to develop.
Mace is an inclusive employer and welcomes interest from a diverse range of candidates. Even if you feel you do not fulfill all the criteria, please apply, as you may still be the best candidate for this role or another role within our organisation.
We are also open to discussing part-time, flexible, and hybrid working options if suitable within the role.
